commands.name: GetAddOnVersion
commands.description: Retrieves the version of the Tapir Additional JSON Commands Add-On.

commands.name: GetCommands
commands.description: Retrieves every command of the Tapir Add-On with its command group, the Tapir version it was introduced in and its description, so a script can check that a command exists before calling it.

commands.name: GetArchicadLocation
commands.description: Retrieves the location of the currently running Archicad executable.

commands.name: GetArchicadReleaseInfo
commands.description: Retrieves the main version, release version and build number of the running Archicad, with the caption of its window.

commands.name: GetArchicadLicenseInfo
commands.description: Retrieves the license the running Archicad runs on: its type (Full, Education, Trial, Demo, Start or BIMcloud Team Client), the raw protection mode with its bits by name, and the highest Software Service Agreement (SSA) level of the license, so a script can warn before it uses a feature the license lacks.

commands.name: GetPrinterInfo
commands.description: Retrieves Archicad's current print settings: the print area, grid, fixed text size and scale (the settings PrintView takes).

commands.name: GetPrinterAndPlotterInfo
commands.description: Retrieves the printer selected in Archicad, with its name and orientation, and the selected plotter, with its name and model.

commands.name: QuitArchicad
commands.description: Performs a quit operation on the currently running Archicad instance.

commands.name: GetPointFromUser
commands.description: Asks the designer to click a point in the current window and returns it.

commands.name: ModelToScreen
commands.description: Converts model coordinates to pixel positions local to the current Archicad view window (not global desktop coordinates), using the current window's size, drawing scale and zoom.

commands.name: ScreenToModel
commands.description: Converts pixel positions local to the current Archicad view window to 2D model coordinates of the current database, using the current window's size, drawing scale and zoom.

commands.name: GetElementFromUser
commands.description: Asks the designer to click an element in the current window and returns its id, its type and the clicked point.

commands.name: GetCurrentTool
commands.description: Returns the tool active in the Toolbox: its element type, its variation (the subtype, e.g. Door, Skylight or a library part subtype of an add-on) and, for the tools of add-ons, its class id, in the form SetCurrentTool accepts.

commands.name: SetCurrentTool
commands.description: Activates a tool in the Toolbox, given as GetCurrentTool or GetToolboxItems returns it; an empty input activates the Arrow.

commands.name: GetToolboxItems
commands.description: Lists the tools of the Toolbox, the tools of add-ons included, in the form SetCurrentTool accepts, and the active tool. includeHidden also lists the tools without an icon, e.g. the Slab Accessory.

commands.name: GetLineFromUser
commands.description: Waits for the user to input a line in the active Archicad window and returns start and end coordinates.

commands.name: GetArcFromUser
commands.description: Asks the designer to draw an arc in the current window - its center, its start point (which sets the radius) and its end point - with a rubber-band circle shown while drawing, and returns its center, radius, start and end angles, the angle it turns through, its direction and its start and end points.

commands.name: GetPolygonFromUser
commands.description: Waits for the user to input a polygon in the active Archicad window and returns its points and arcs.

commands.name: GetMagicWandSettings
commands.description: Returns the settings of Archicad's Magic Wand Settings dialog: how curves are approximated with straight segments (a number of segments along arcs or circles, a largest deviation from the curve, or a segment length) and the trace method.

commands.name: ConvertImages
commands.description: Converts base64 encoded images from one image format to another with Archicad's own image converters, for example a PNG preview image to JPEG.

commands.name: GetCurrentWindowType
commands.description: Returns the type of the current (active) window and, when it has one, the databaseId of the database it shows, which ChangeWindow takes to bring the window back after a script switched to another one.

commands.name: GetCurrentWindowDrawingScale
commands.description: Returns the drawing scale of the current (active) window, the scale shown in the bottom bar, as its denominator: 100.0 for 1:100, 20.0 for 1:20.

commands.name: SetCurrentWindowDrawingScale
commands.description: Changes the drawing scale of the current (active) window, the scale shown in the bottom bar, to the given denominator: 100 for 1:100.

commands.name: ChangeWindow
commands.description: Changes the current (active) window to the given window.

commands.name: GetContainingDatabases
commands.description: Returns the database (window type, database id and name) that contains each of the given elements, from any database, not only the current one.

commands.name: CloseWindows
commands.description: Closes the windows of the given databases (for example layouts, sections or details opened earlier with ChangeWindow), with one execution result per window; a window Archicad cannot close gets a failed result.

commands.name: RebuildCurrentDatabase
commands.description: Rebuilds the current database, the one the API works on (see ChangeWindow).

commands.name: DeleteGhostRecords
commands.description: Deletes the trace (ghost) record of each given parent database, which removes the trace reference shown in that database's window.

commands.name: GetUserGSID
commands.description: Get the current registered User-GSID and OrganizationsID.

commands.name: ShowAlert
commands.description: Display a dialog with up to three buttons.

commands.name: ShowNotificationBubble
commands.description: Shows a non-blocking notification bubble with a message in the current Archicad window, e.g. to report progress or a result without stopping the user as ShowAlert does.

commands.name: GetSpecialFolders
commands.description: Retrieves the filesystem paths of the special folders of the running Archicad (preferences, cache, data, temporary, application, defaults, templates, help, embedded project library, etc.).

commands.name: GetEditModeState
commands.description: Tells whether Archicad is in a hierarchical editing mode (curtain wall, stair, beam or column editing), and which element is being edited.

commands.name: GetArchicadVisibility
commands.description: Returns whether the Archicad application is shown or hidden.

commands.name: SetArchicadVisibility
commands.description: Hides or shows the Archicad application, e.g. to keep it out of the way while a batch runs.

commands.name: RunActionCenterChecks
commands.description: Runs the given checks of the Action Center (by default the hotlink check).

commands.name: RedrawCurrentDatabase
commands.description: Redraws the current database, even when its window is in the background.

commands.name: GetProductVersionInfo
commands.description: Retrieves the version information of the running Archicad: build number, language code, product family and version text, plus the product name, product type, main/update/hotfix versions, the available domains (Architecture, MEP) and the CEIP project identifier of the open project from Archicad 29.

commands.name: Get3DCutawayStatus
commands.description: Returns whether 3D Cutaway is on and whether the cutting planes are shown in the 3D window.

commands.name: Set3DCutawayStatus
commands.description: Turns 3D Cutaway on or off and shows or hides the cutting planes in the 3D window.

commands.name: SetDialogAutoClose
commands.description: Turns the dialog auto close on or off.

commands.name: GetDialogAutoClose
commands.description: Tells whether the dialog auto close is on, the same state SetDialogAutoClose writes, so a script can restore it afterwards.

commands.name: GetProjectInfo
commands.description: Retrieves information about the currently loaded project.

commands.name: GetProjectInfoFields
commands.description: Retrieves the names and values of all project info fields.

commands.name: SetProjectInfoField
commands.description: Sets the value of a project info field.

commands.name: CreateProjectInfoFields
commands.description: Creates one or more custom project info fields.

commands.name: DeleteProjectInfoFields
commands.description: Deletes one or more custom project info fields, by their autotext keys or, from Archicad 30, by the ids of the fields of the Project Info groups.

commands.name: RenameProjectInfoFields
commands.description: Renames custom fields of the Project Info groups.

commands.name: MoveProjectInfoFields
commands.description: Moves fields of the Project Info groups to a group, before another field of it or to its end.

commands.name: GetProjectInfoGroups
commands.description: Retrieves the Project Info groups in their order, each with its fields: id, name, value and, when exactly one project info autotext has the name of the field, the autotext key that SetProjectInfoField takes.

commands.name: CreateProjectInfoGroups
commands.description: Creates Project Info groups with the given names, at the end of the group list.

commands.name: RenameProjectInfoGroups
commands.description: Renames Project Info groups.

commands.name: DeleteProjectInfoGroups
commands.description: Deletes Project Info groups.

commands.name: MoveProjectInfoGroups
commands.description: Moves Project Info groups before another group, or to the end of the group list when no other group is given.

commands.name: GetStories
commands.description: Retrieves information about the story structure of the currently loaded project: index, floor id, name, level, height and, from Archicad 28, the IFC GlobalId of each story.

commands.name: SetStories
commands.description: Sets the story structure of the currently loaded project to the given list of stories.

commands.name: InsertStory
commands.description: Inserts one new story directly above or below an existing story, with its name, height and level line display, and returns the new story as GetStories reports it.

commands.name: DeleteStory
commands.description: Deletes one story.

commands.name: ModifyStory
commands.description: Changes the name, level, height or level line display of one story, and returns the story as GetStories reports it.

commands.name: GetAutoTextKeys
commands.description: Retrieves the available autotext keys (name and embeddable key): the Project Info, layout, drawing, date and other autotexts Archicad lists, and the property based ones, optionally for a specific element.

commands.name: GetAutoTextName
commands.description: Retrieves the display names of one or more autotext keys (as returned inside a '<...>' embedded key), with a direct guid lookup for property-based keys instead of enumerating every property definition.

commands.name: GetAllAutoTextKeys
commands.description: Retrieves every autotext key Archicad knows (not only the property-based ones returned by GetAutoTextKeys) with its current value, resolved without an element context.

commands.name: InterpretAutoTexts
commands.description: Resolves one or more autotexts (e.g. '<LAYOUTID>') to their values, optionally in the context of an element, so a key can be tested before it is written into a Text or Label.

commands.name: GetNoteAutotexts
commands.description: Retrieves the autotexts available in the notes of an element type (e.g. a Dimension), each with the element types it is available for.

commands.name: GetNoteAutoTextKeywords
commands.description: Retrieves the keywords of note autotexts (the autotexts of dimension, label and other element notes) by their numeric API_NoteAutotextID values.

commands.name: GetHotlinks
commands.description: Gets the file system locations (path) of the hotlink modules and the instance elements placed from each node.

commands.name: CreateHotlinkNodes
commands.description: Creates hotlink module nodes from source files.

commands.name: CreateHotlinkInstances
commands.description: Places instances of hotlink module nodes at an origin, rotation and mirroring.

commands.name: ChangeHotlinkInstances
commands.description: Moves, rotates or mirrors placed hotlink instances by changing their transformation.

commands.name: UpdateHotlinks
commands.description: Re-reads the source files of hotlink module nodes and refreshes their cached content in the project, as the Hotlink Manager's Update button does.

commands.name: ChangeHotlinkNodes
commands.description: Repoints hotlink module nodes at other source files, as the Hotlink Manager's Relink button does.

commands.name: BreakHotlinkNodes
commands.description: Breaks hotlink nodes, as the Hotlink Manager's Break Hotlink does: the elements of each node's placed instances stay in the project as ordinary elements, no longer tied to the source file.

commands.name: DeleteHotlinkNodes
commands.description: Deletes hotlink nodes together with their placed instances, as the Hotlink Manager's Delete does.

commands.name: MergeFile
commands.description: Merges an Archicad project or module file into the model, as File > Interoperability > Merge does, at an origin, rotation and mirroring, each story of the file on the story with the same index (or from floorIndex on).

commands.name: GetHotlinkOwnersOfElements
commands.description: Tells for each element whether it comes from a hotlinked module, and returns the hotlink element that contains it and the hotlink instance it belongs to.

commands.name: GetHotlinkProxyElementTable
commands.description: Maps the proxy elements of placed hotlink instances to the elements of the source file they were made from, so an element seen in a hotlinked module can be traced back to its source element.

commands.name: GetHotlinkSourceStatus
commands.description: Tells for each hotlink source file whether it is available, missing, not accessible, incompatible or offline.

commands.name: OpenProject
commands.description: Opens the given project.

commands.name: NewProject
commands.description: Starts a new, untitled project from the template set in Archicad's New Project settings, as File > New does; with newAndReset also the working environment is reset, as New and Reset All does.

commands.name: CloseProject
commands.description: Closes the currently opened project.

commands.name: SaveProject
commands.description: Saves the currently opened project, in place or to a given path.

commands.name: SaveAsModuleFile
commands.description: Saves the given elements, or the current selection, as a hotlink module (.mod) file.

commands.name: SaveProjectAsArchive
commands.description: Saves the open project as an archive (.pla) file, with the library parts it uses inside.

commands.name: GetRenderingScenes
commands.description: Gets the names of the rendering scenes of the project (the Scene list of the PhotoRendering Settings palette), the most recently used first, and the name of the current scene.

commands.name: SetCurrentRenderingScene
commands.description: Makes the given rendering scene the current one, as selecting it in the PhotoRendering Settings palette does.

commands.name: PhotoRender
commands.description: Renders the 3D model with the current rendering scene, or with the given one, as Document > Creative Imaging > PhotoRender Projection does, and saves the image to a file (png, jpg, bmp, tiff or gif).

commands.name: SaveCurrentWindowAsImage
commands.description: Saves what the current window shows as an image file (png, jpg, bmp, tiff or gif), as File > Save as does with a picture format.

commands.name: GetCurrentViewImage
commands.description: Returns what the 3D window, or the PhotoRendering window, shows as a base64 encoded png or jpg image with its size in pixels, without writing a file.

commands.name: GetCalculationUnits
commands.description: Gets the project calculation units.

commands.name: GetDimensionStandards
commands.description: Gets the dimension standards of the project (Options > Project Preferences > Dimensions) with their name and the unit, decimals and rounding of each dimension type, optionally only the one with the given name.

commands.name: GetExportTolerance
commands.description: Gets the export tolerance: the largest distance allowed between an arc and the straight segments that replace it when curves are segmented for export.

commands.name: GetLast3DDefaultLevels
commands.description: Gets the last 3D default levels of the given element types' defaults.

commands.name: SetLast3DDefaultLevels
commands.description: Sets the last 3D default levels of the given element types' defaults.

commands.name: GetProjectPreferences
commands.description: Gets pages of the project preferences (Options > Project Preferences): the working units, the dimensions, the calculation units, the zones and the reference levels, and the Floor Plan Cut Plane Settings.

commands.name: SetProjectPreferences
commands.description: Changes pages of the project preferences (Options > Project Preferences): the working units, the dimensions, the calculation units, the zones and the reference levels, and the Floor Plan Cut Plane Settings.

commands.name: ConvertUnitValues
commands.description: Formats lengths, areas, volumes and angles (given in meters, square meters, cubic meters and radians) as Archicad shows them with the unit and rounding of the given Project Preference, returning the text, its extra accuracy decimals and the unit.

commands.name: GetRenovationStatusNames
commands.description: Gets the names the running Archicad shows for the renovation statuses Existing, New and Demolished (localized).

commands.name: GetGeoLocation
commands.description: Gets the project location details: the project location, and the survey point's position, geo-referencing parameters, visibility and lock state (the lock from Archicad 26).

commands.name: GetSurveyPointTransformation
commands.description: Gets the 3x4 matrix that transforms points from the Project Origin coordinate system into the Survey Point coordinate system, row by row, and its inverse when it is invertible.

commands.name: SetGeoLocation
commands.description: Sets the project location details: the project location, and the survey point's position, geo-referencing parameters, visibility and lock state (the lock from Archicad 26).

commands.name: SetPlaceSettings
commands.description: Changes the place settings of the project: location (longitude, latitude, altitude, north), date, time, summer time and time zone.

commands.name: FindDimensionStandard
commands.description: Finds a dimension standard (Options > Project Preferences > Dimensions) by its name and returns its index, name and guid.

commands.name: GetProjectNotes
commands.description: Gets the Project Notes of the project (File > Info > Project Notes): client, project name, company, address, architect, draftsmen, project status, date of issue, keywords and notes.

commands.name: SetProjectNotes
commands.description: Changes the Project Notes of the project (File > Info > Project Notes).

commands.name: GetSunSettings
commands.description: Gets the project's date and time (Options > Project Preferences > Location Settings), the sun position Archicad calculates for them at the project location, and the sun and ambient light settings.

commands.name: CalculateSunPosition
commands.description: Calculates the sun position (azimuth and altitude in degrees) for a date and time, at the project location unless another one is given, without changing the project.

commands.name: GetCoordinateOrigins
commands.description: Gets the offset of the virtual coordinate system origin from the world origin, and the user origin of the current database.

commands.name: PrintView
commands.description: Prints from the current view.

commands.name: RebuildView
commands.description: Rebuilds the current view.

commands.name: GetAutoIntersect
commands.description: Gets whether Auto-Intersection (Options > Auto-Intersection) is on.

commands.name: SetAutoIntersect
commands.description: Turns Auto-Intersection on or off.

commands.name: ResolveNames
commands.description: Looks up words or phrases (for example from a user's question) among the names of the open project before they are passed to other commands: stories, layers, layer combinations, building materials, composites, profiles, surfaces, fills, lines, zone categories, element types (by API name and, from Archicad 27, by the name the Archicad interface shows), properties (by name, and by group and name together) and classifications (systems by name and version, items of every system by name and ID).

commands.name: SetElementUserData
commands.description: Stores string values under keys on elements, for scripts to keep their own state per element (external database ids, sync timestamps, markers).

commands.name: GetElementUserData
commands.description: Reads the values stored on elements by SetElementUserData: every key of each element, or only the given keys.

commands.name: GetSelectedElements
commands.description: Gets the list of the currently selected elements.

commands.name: GetElementsByType
commands.description: Returns the identifier of every element of the given type on the plan.

commands.name: GetAllElements
commands.description: Returns the identifier of all elements on the plan.

commands.name: CaptureElementState
commands.description: Captures the current state of the elements of the project and returns a stateId for it, so that GetElementChangesSince can later list what was created, modified and deleted since.

commands.name: GetElementChangesSince
commands.description: Returns the new, modified and deleted elements between a state captured by CaptureElementState and either another captured state (toStateId) or the current state of the project.

commands.name: ReleaseElementState
commands.description: Frees a state captured by CaptureElementState.

commands.name: GetElementTypeNames
commands.description: Gets the localized names of the given element types, as the running Archicad shows them (for example 'Wand' for Wall in German Archicad).

commands.name: GetElementsInCreationOrder
commands.description: Returns the identifier of every element of the current database, or of the given databases, in the order the elements were created.

commands.name: ChangeSelectionOfElements
commands.description: Adds/removes a number of elements to/from the current selection.

commands.name: DeselectAll
commands.description: Clears the selection in the current window.

commands.name: GetMarquee
commands.description: Gets the marquee of the current window: its shape (rectangle, rotated rectangle or polygon), whether it is multi-story, and its outline as a polygon.

commands.name: SetMarquee
commands.description: Draws a marquee in the current window from a polygon or a box (optionally rotated), single- or multi-story.

commands.name: FilterElements
commands.description: Keeps the elements that match all the given criteria: Archicad's flag filters (filters), layer (layerIndices), home story (floorIndices), element type (elementTypes) and hotlink (fromHotlink, hotlinkIds).

commands.name: GetElementsByCriteria
commands.description: Returns the elements, or with countOnly only their number, that match all the given criteria: element types, home stories, layers, Archicad's element filter flags and property criteria (a value compared in internal units, or a value status such as hasValue, isUserUndefined, isNotAvailable, isDefault or hasCustomValue).

commands.name: GetDetailsOfElements
commands.description: Gets the details of elements (geometry parameters etc).

commands.name: SetDetailsOfElements
commands.description: Sets the details of the given elements.

commands.name: SetElementInfoStrings
commands.description: Sets the info string of the given elements: the Element ID shown in the Info Box, which GetDetailsOfElements returns as id.

commands.name: GetElementCategories
commands.description: Lists the element categories of the project (Structural Function, Position, Renovation Status, Renovation Filter and, in the German version, BRI) with their possible values.

commands.name: GetCategoryValuesOfElements
commands.description: Gets the category values (Structural Function, Position, Renovation Status ...) of the given elements, optionally only for the given category types.

commands.name: GetCategoryValuesOfDefaults
commands.description: Gets the category values (Structural Function, Position, Renovation Status ...) of the tool defaults of the given element types, the values new elements of the type get, optionally only for the given category types.

commands.name: SetCategoryValuesOfDefaults
commands.description: Sets the category values (Structural Function, Position, Renovation Status ...) of the tool defaults of the given element types: the values new elements of the type get, as the Renovation palette does for the Renovation Status.

commands.name: SetCategoryValuesOfElements
commands.description: Sets the category values (Structural Function, Position, Renovation Status ...) of the given elements, one element and one category per item, in a single undoable step.

commands.name: Get3DBoundingBoxes
commands.description: Get the 3D bounding box of elements.

commands.name: Get2DBoundingBoxes
commands.description: Get the 2D bounding box of elements as Archicad draws them, in the coordinates of the database the element is in: the floor plan, a section, a worksheet, a layout or a master layout.

commands.name: GetLibPartTransformations
commands.description: Gets the placement transformation of library part instances (Window, Door, Object, Lamp, Zone) as Archicad computes it: the location, the rotation angle and the x/y scaling.

commands.name: GetSnapPointsOfElements
commands.description: Gets the snap points (hotspots) of the given elements, of any element type: the points of an element that the cursor snaps to and dimensions attach to (for example the endpoints of a Wall's reference line or the vertices of a Slab), in world coordinates, each with the neig kind and subindex identifying which point of the element it is.

commands.name: ConvertRevealOffsets
commands.description: Converts the reveal depth offset of windows and doors placed in walls between the two references Archicad uses: measured from the core skin of a composite wall, or from the wall side.

commands.name: Get3DGeometryOfElements
commands.description: Gets the 3D geometry of elements as the solid bodies of their 3D model: a vertex list in world coordinates and the planar faces (with their holes) referencing it, each face with its surface attribute when that is a project attribute.

commands.name: GetElementConnections
commands.description: Gets the connections among the given elements: each pair of touching elements once, with the polygons of the surface where they touch, in world coordinates.

commands.name: GetBodyMaterialsOfElements
commands.description: Gets the building material of each body of the 3D model of the given elements.

commands.name: GetCutPolygonsOfElements
commands.description: Cuts each body of the 3D model of the given elements with a plane and returns, for each body, its building material, the area of the cut surface and its polygons (outline and holes) in 2D coordinates of the plane.

commands.name: GetElementAtCoordinate
commands.description: Finds the element of the given polygonal type (for example Slab, Roof, Mesh, Zone or Hatch) at a coordinate of the floor plan of the current database, the way a click there would.

commands.name: GetSkylightHolePolygons
commands.description: Gets the polygon of the hole each given Skylight cuts into its host Roof or Shell: the outline and any holes of it as 2D coordinates.

commands.name: GetVisibleSkinStatus
commands.description: Checks whether elements have a visible skin in a given Partial Structure Display mode (EntireStructure, CoreOnly, WithoutFinishes or StructureOnly), e.g. a finish-only slab has none in CoreOnly.

commands.name: GetRoofPlanes
commands.description: Gets the single planes of roofs, without changing the roofs.

commands.name: GetCurtainWallAbsoluteBottoms
commands.description: Gets the absolute bottom level of curtain walls or their subelements (segments, frames, panels, junctions, accessories).

commands.name: GetQuantitiesOfElements
commands.description: Gets the quantities of the given elements calculated by Archicad (volumes, surfaces, lengths etc.), together with the volume and projected area per building material (one item per skin of composite and complex profile elements, one item for basic elements).

commands.name: TriangulatePolygonsOfElements
commands.description: Triangulates the plan polygon of the given elements, holes excluded, as Archicad does it: the outline of a Slab, Zone, Hatch or Mesh and the polygon of a Roof.

commands.name: GetTextureCoordinates
commands.description: Gets the texture coordinates (u, v) of the faces of the 3D model of the given elements: per solid body, per face, at the first vertex of the face.

commands.name: GetSurfaceTypesOfElements
commands.description: Gets the surface type of every polygon of the 3D model of the given elements, as ACAPI_Polygon_PolygonId2SurfaceType returns it: for each element its polygons with their body index, polygon index, polygon id and the numeric API_SurfaceTypeID value.

commands.name: Get3DModelCounts
commands.description: Gets the number of components of each type (bodies, polygons, polygon edges, edges, vertices, normal vectors, materials and lights) in the 3D model Archicad currently holds.

commands.name: DeleteUserDataOfElements
commands.description: Deletes the user data this add-on stored on the given elements.

commands.name: GetSurfaceQuantitiesOfElements
commands.description: Gets the exposed surface areas of the given elements calculated by Archicad: for each element one item per surface attribute and building material pair with the area that is not covered by the covering elements (for example the wall area behind a slab is taken off the wall's surface).

commands.name: GetSubelementsOfHierarchicalElements
commands.description: Gets the subelements of the given hierarchical elements.

commands.name: GetRailingSegmentPatterns
commands.description: Gets the pattern of each segment of the given railings, telling the entry apart from its instances: the entry is the segment's pattern settings (distribution, panel, baluster set with its spacing, baluster and inner post) that Archicad generates the pattern from, the instances are the RailingPattern, RailingPanel, RailingBalusterSet and RailingInnerPost subelements it generated for the segment, whose own settings GetDetailsOfElements reads.

commands.name: GetHierarchicalElementOwners
commands.description: Gets the owner of each given element in its hierarchical element: the root (e.g. the Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing of a frame, tread or post) or the immediate parent.

commands.name: GetElementFieldDefinitions
commands.description: Lists every field of an element type's struct in the Archicad API (e.g. API_AngleDimensionType) that GetElementFields reads and SetElementFields writes (and GetFieldsOfElementDefaults and SetFieldsOfElementDefaults in the tool defaults): its path, JSON type, C++ kind, size and whether it is read-only.

commands.name: GetElementFields
commands.description: Reads fields of elements by their path in the element's struct in the Archicad API (e.g. note.noteFont of an angle dimension, u.planeRoof.angle of a roof): every field, or only the given ones.

commands.name: SetElementFields
commands.description: Writes fields of elements by their path in the element's struct in the Archicad API (see GetElementFieldDefinitions), with ACAPI_Element_Change and a mask of exactly the given fields, in one undoable command.

commands.name: GetFieldsOfElementDefaults
commands.description: Reads fields of the tool defaults of element types, the settings new elements of the type get, by their path in the element's struct in the Archicad API (see GetElementFieldDefinitions), e.g. thickness of the wall defaults: every field, or only the given ones.

commands.name: SetFieldsOfElementDefaults
commands.description: Writes fields of the tool defaults of element types by their path in the element's struct in the Archicad API (see GetElementFieldDefinitions), with ACAPI_Element_ChangeDefaults and a mask of exactly the given fields: the elements created afterwards get them.

commands.name: EditHierarchicalElement
commands.description: Opens the given hierarchical element (Curtain Wall, Stair, Railing, Beam or Column) in its hierarchical 3D editing mode, as the Edit button of the element does.

commands.name: FinishHierarchicalEditing
commands.description: Finishes the current hierarchical editing mode (Curtain Wall, Stair, Railing, Beam or Column): accept true keeps the changes (OK), accept false discards them (Cancel).

commands.name: GetConnectedElements
commands.description: Gets the elements hosted by (connected to) the given owner elements, filtered to the given element type: for example the Windows or Doors of a Wall, the frames, panels, junctions and accessories of a Curtain Wall, the risers, treads and structures of a Stair, or the posts, rails and panels of a Railing.

commands.name: GetElementsInDrawOrder
commands.description: Returns the identifier of every element of the current database, or of the given databases, in Archicad's drawing order (the order set by Bring to Front and Send to Back), as ACAPI_DrawOrder_DrawOrderGetNext walks it.

commands.name: GetDrawingPrimitivesOfElements
commands.description: Returns the 2D drawing primitives (points, lines, arcs, texts, polylines, triangles, polygons, pictures) Archicad draws each given floor plan element from, in drawing order, as ACAPI_DrawingPrimitive_ShapePrimsExt decomposes it on every story and unclipped.

commands.name: GetStoryControlPrimitives
commands.description: Returns the 2D drawing primitives of the story levels (story lines and their markers) drawn in the given section, elevation or interior elevation database, as ACAPI_DrawingPrimitive_DrawStoryControl draws them, in the same format as GetDrawingPrimitivesOfElements.

commands.name: GetShapePrimitivesOfElements
commands.description: Returns the 2D drawing primitives of each given floor plan element in the same format as GetDrawingPrimitivesOfElements, but drawn as ACAPI_DrawingPrimitive_ShapePrims draws it by default (on the current story, clipped as Archicad clips it) instead of on every story and unclipped.

commands.name: GetSectionElements
commands.description: Gets the elements drawn in the given section, elevation or interior elevation databases, each with the owner element it was generated from.

commands.name: GetRelationsOfElements
commands.description: Gets the type-specific relations of the given elements: endpoint and reference line connections of walls, beams and beam segments, boundary elements and boundary sections of zones, the zones on the two sides of windows, doors, skylights and curtain wall panels, and the zones connected to roofs and shells.

commands.name: LinkElements
commands.description: Creates persistent links between pairs of elements, each from one element to another, with an optional integer flags value per link.

commands.name: UnlinkElements
commands.description: Removes the links created by LinkElements between the given pairs of elements.

commands.name: GetLinksOfElements
commands.description: Gets the links created by LinkElements that start from the given elements: the linked element and the flags of each link.

commands.name: GetZoneBoundaries
commands.description: Gets the boundaries of the given Zones (connected elements, neighbour zones, etc.).

commands.name: GetZoneReductions
commands.description: Gets the area reductions of the given Zones, as the Zone Stamp's area calculation uses them: the polygons of the Zone covered by Walls, Columns, reducing Fills, sloping Roofs and low ceilings, each with its type, the percentage it is reduced by, its area and its outline with holes.

commands.name: GetPropertyObjectsOfElements
commands.description: Gets the property objects of the given elements: the library parts of the old listing system (used by projects migrated from older Archicad versions) linked to each element by criteria or individually, with the library part's index (the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts), name and guid.

commands.name: GetDescriptorsOfElements
commands.description: Gets the descriptors of the given elements: the listing descriptors in the property objects of each element, with the library part that declares them (index, name and guid), their listing database set and index, and their status (Normal, Deleted or Local).

commands.name: GetLinkedPropertyObjectsOfElements
commands.description: Gets how property objects (the library parts of the old listing system) are linked to the given elements, or to the element defaults of the given element types: whether the property objects matching their criteria are linked, which of them match, and which one is assigned individually, each with the library part's index (the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts), name and guid.

commands.name: SetLinkedPropertyObjectsOfElements
commands.description: Sets how property objects (the library parts of the old listing system) are linked to the given elements, or to the element defaults of the given element types: whether the property objects matching their criteria are linked, and which one is assigned individually (0 removes the individual assignment).

commands.name: UpdateZones
commands.description: Updates Zones (recalculates their geometry, updates their Zone Stamps and the connected elements): the selected Zones, every Zone when nothing is selected, or the Zones given in zones.

commands.name: SetZoneLabelingSettings
commands.description: Turns the automatic labeling of Zones on or off and selects the Label Favorite it places.

commands.name: GetZoneLabelingSettings
commands.description: Returns whether the automatic labeling of Zones is on and the name of the Label Favorite it places.

commands.name: GetCollisions
commands.description: Detect collisions between the given two groups of elements.

commands.name: HighlightElements
commands.description: Highlights the elements given in the elements array.

commands.name: MoveElements
commands.description: Moves elements with a given vector.

commands.name: AlignElements
commands.description: Aligns elements on the floor plan or in the current 2D view to one edge of their plan bounding boxes (left, right, top or bottom) or to their middle (centerX, centerY), either of the whole set or of a reference element, by moving them in one undo step.

commands.name: DistributeElements
commands.description: Distributes 3 or more elements on the floor plan or in the current 2D view evenly along X (horizontal) or Y (vertical), with equal distances between the middles of their plan bounding boxes (centers) or equal space between the boxes (gaps), by moving them in one undo step.

commands.name: SplitElements
commands.description: Splits each given element along a line (the infinite line through its begin and end point, like Archicad's Split command).

commands.name: CopyElementsToDatabase
commands.description: Copies 2D elements (lines, polylines, arcs, circles, splines, hotspots, texts, hatches, independent labels) from one database into another, e.g. from a worksheet into another worksheet, a detail or a layout, optionally moved by an offset.

commands.name: ElevateElements
commands.description: Moves elements vertically by a given offset in meters, like Edit > Move > Elevate.

commands.name: RotateElements
commands.description: Rotates elements around a reference point.

commands.name: MirrorElements
commands.description: Mirrors elements across an axis given by two points on the floor plan, optionally as a copy.

commands.name: CopyElements
commands.description: Copies elements by an offset, like dragging a copy in Archicad, keeping all their settings.

commands.name: RotateCopyElements
commands.description: Copies elements rotated around a center on the floor plan by an angle in radians, like rotating a copy in Archicad, keeping all their settings.

commands.name: ScaleElements
commands.description: Scales elements on the floor plan or in the current 2D view by a factor around a center point with Archicad's Resize edit, in one undo step.

commands.name: DeleteElements
commands.description: Deletes elements, each in the database that contains it (the floor plan, a section, a worksheet, a layout, ...), whichever window is the current one; the current window stays.

commands.name: DeleteSelectedElements
commands.description: Deletes the currently selected elements in one undo step, the same as pressing the Delete key.

commands.name: LockElements
commands.description: Locks the given elements.

commands.name: UnlockElements
commands.description: Unlocks the given elements.

commands.name: RefreshElements
commands.description: Refreshes (rebuilds) the given elements, for example placed Objects, Windows and Doors that still show the old geometry after their library part's script or embedded file changed.

commands.name: GetGDLParametersOfElements
commands.description: Gets all the GDL parameters (name, type, value) of the given elements. parameterNames returns only the named parameters, and includePossibleValues false leaves out the value lists (which for font parameters list every installed font), for a much smaller answer.

commands.name: SetGDLParametersOfElements
commands.description: Sets the given GDL parameters of the given elements.

commands.name: GetMarkerParametersOfElements
commands.description: Gets the marker library part and the marker's GDL parameters (name, type, value) of the given Window, Door and Change Marker elements.

commands.name: SetMarkerParametersOfElements
commands.description: Sets the given GDL parameters of the marker of the given Window, Door and Change Marker elements (the marker head of a Change Marker).

commands.name: GetURLReferencesOfElements
commands.description: Gets the web link (URL reference) of the given elements: a URL with a description, shown in Archicad in the element's settings under Element Information > Link.

commands.name: SetURLReferencesOfElements
commands.description: Sets the web link (URL reference) of the given elements: a URL with a description, shown in Archicad in the element's settings under Element Information > Link.

commands.name: ChangeLibraryPartOfElements
commands.description: Changes the library part of the given Object, Lamp, Window, Door, Skylight, Zone and symbol Label elements to another library part of the same type (Wall End parts for wall ends), given by name, index or guid, e.g. to replace missing library parts with ones from the loaded libraries.

commands.name: GetCalculatedParametersOfCurtainWallSubElements
commands.description: Gets the GDL parameters (name, type, value) of the given Curtain Wall Frame, Panel, Junction and Accessory elements as Archicad calculated them for their place in the curtain wall.

commands.name: GetHotspotsOfElements
commands.description: Gets the 2D hotspots of the given library part instances (Objects, Lamps, Windows, Doors, Skylights, Zones, Curtain Wall parts, etc.), in the library part's own coordinate system.

commands.name: SetMarkerLibraryPartOfElements
commands.description: Changes which library part the marker of the given Window and Door elements uses, given by its name (find the available ones with GetAvailableLibraryParts); only a marker library part for the opening's type is accepted.

commands.name: RunParameterScriptOfElements
commands.description: Runs the parameter script of the library part of the given elements (objects, lamps, windows, doors, etc.), so that parameter values that depend on other parameters are updated, e.g. after SetGDLParametersOfElements.

commands.name: CreateColumns
commands.description: Creates Column elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateWalls
commands.description: Creates Wall elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateBeams
commands.description: Creates Beam elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateStairs
commands.description: Creates Stair elements based on the given baseline and parameters, optionally with the segment type of each baseline edge and the turn at each baseline point (landings and winders), and with curved baseline edges (baseLineArcs) for curved and spiral stairs.

commands.name: SolveStairBaseline
commands.description: Runs the Archicad stair solver on the given Stair baselines (straight or with curved edges) and parameters without creating any element.

commands.name: CreateSlabs
commands.description: Creates Slab elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateWindows
commands.description: Creates Window elements in host walls based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateDoors
commands.description: Creates Door elements in host walls based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateOpenings
commands.description: Creates Opening elements in the given host elements.

commands.name: GetOpeningDefault
commands.description: Returns the settings of the Opening tool defaults: the extrusion parameters (as GetOpeningDetails returns them) and the floor plan parameters (as GetOpeningFloorPlanParameters returns them).

commands.name: SetOpeningDefault
commands.description: Changes the settings of the Opening tool defaults, with the names GetOpeningDefault returns.

commands.name: PlaceOpenings
commands.description: Places openings with the Opening tool settings at points of their parent elements.

commands.name: GetOpeningFloorPlanParameters
commands.description: Returns the floor plan parameters of Opening elements: the floor plan display mode, the divided opening mode, the open edge style, the reference axis, the cut surface and outline lines, the cover fills and the cut and uncut symbols.

commands.name: SetOpeningFloorPlanParameters
commands.description: Changes the floor plan parameters of Opening elements returned by GetOpeningFloorPlanParameters, and sets or removes their cut and uncut symbols.

commands.name: GetOpeningSymbolParameters
commands.description: Returns the GDL parameters of the cut and uncut floor plan symbols of Opening elements, in the format of GetGDLParametersOfElements.

commands.name: SetOpeningSymbolParameters
commands.description: Changes the GDL parameters of the cut and uncut floor plan symbols of Opening elements, in the format of SetGDLParametersOfElements.

commands.name: GetOpeningDetails
commands.description: Returns the details of Opening elements: whether they exist, the parent element, the cut and connected elements, the geometry (anchor point, extrusion direction, axes, polygon) and the extrusion parameters (constraint, limit type, linked status, shape type, size, anchor, offsets, surface overrides).

commands.name: SetOpeningDetails
commands.description: Changes the details of Opening elements: the parent element, the cut elements, the polygon, a transformation of the geometry and the extrusion parameters (constraint, limit type, linked status, shape type, size, anchor, offsets, surface overrides) returned by GetOpeningDetails.

commands.name: CreateMorphs
commands.description: Creates Morph elements from simple box definitions or arbitrary bodies.

commands.name: CreateRoofs
commands.description: Creates Roof elements based on footprint, level and roof profile data.

commands.name: CreateShells
commands.description: Creates extruded, revolved and ruled Shell elements from profile polylines, with thickness, structure, an optional clipping contour and holes.

commands.name: CreateSkylights
commands.description: Creates Skylight elements with a roof or shell owner and a floor plan anchor position.

commands.name: ModifySkylights
commands.description: Modifies Skylight elements: anchor position and anchor point, fix mode, width, height, azimuth and elevation angles, mirroring, floor plan display option, pens, line types, section fill and pens, surface and the use-the-library-part's-settings flags - the same settings CreateSkylights takes and GetDetailsOfElements returns.

commands.name: CreateRailings
commands.description: Creates Railing elements along a reference polyline.

commands.name: CreateRailingsFromPolyline
commands.description: Creates Railing elements along a 3D reference polyline: each node has its own elevation and segments can be arcs.

commands.name: CreateCurtainWalls
commands.description: Creates Curtain Wall elements along a reference polyline with a column (primary) and row (secondary) pattern.

commands.name: CreateAssociativeDimensions
commands.description: Creates associative dimensions from explicit witness point references: linear by default, or cumulative, baseline or elevation dimensions (appearance).

commands.name: CreateAssociativeDimensionsOnSection
commands.description: Creates associative dimensions on section elements using common wall, slab, beam, column, door and window presets: linear by default, or cumulative, baseline or elevation dimensions (appearance), e.g. level marks.

commands.name: CreateWallThicknessDimensions
commands.description: Creates associative wall thickness dimensions for the given walls.

commands.name: ModifyAssociativeDimensions
commands.description: Changes the settings of existing linear dimensions (the Dimension tool's elements, also in sections): the dimension type, the elevation origin and elevation marker, the line pen, the marker type, pen and size, the text placement method, the text height, pen, frame, font and style (bold, italic, underline) and the witness line form and value, with the same keys as the dimension creation commands.

commands.name: GetDimensionData
commands.description: Gets the data of existing dimension chains: the line pen, the marker type, pen and size, the text placement method and the default witness line, and per witness point the coordinates, measured value, witness line, the text height, pen, frame, font and style, and the text content (measured value or custom text), superscript and whether the text was moved by hand.

commands.name: GetOpeningTransformations
commands.description: Gets the placement of Opening elements, Windows, Doors and Skylights without changing them: a global-to-local transformation matrix, its inverse, and the origin and axes in world coordinates derived from the inverse.

commands.name: CreateZones
commands.description: Creates Zone elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreatePolylines
commands.description: Creates Polyline elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifyPolylines
commands.description: Changes existing Polyline elements with the keys CreatePolylines takes and GetDetailsOfElements returns: the pen, the line type, zone boundary (roomSeparator), the dash mode (drawSegmentMode), the arrowheads at both ends, and the polygon (coordinates with its arcs, replaced as a whole; the polyline keeps its GUID).

commands.name: CreateLineElements
commands.description: Creates Line elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateArcs
commands.description: Creates Arc elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateCircles
commands.description: Creates Circle elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateHotspots
commands.description: Creates Hotspot elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreatePictures
commands.description: Creates Picture elements from PNG, JPEG, GIF, TIFF or BMP images, given as a file path or as base64 text, at an exact size in model units: give the width, the height or both (one of them keeps the image's proportions).

commands.name: CreateHatches
commands.description: Creates Hatch elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifyHatches
commands.description: Changes existing Hatch (Fill) elements with the keys CreateHatches takes and GetDetailsOfElements returns: the contour pen and line type, the fill pen and background pen or their RGB colors, the fill or building material, the fill category, the fill orientation, the area text and the percentage subtracted from the zone area, and the polygon (coordinates with its arcs and holes, replaced as a whole; the hatch keeps its GUID).

commands.name: CreateSplines
commands.description: Creates Spline elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateObjects
commands.description: Creates Object elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateLamps
commands.description: Creates Lamp elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: GetGridElementDefaults
commands.description: Returns the Grid Tool defaults: library part, size and GDL parameters of a new grid element.

commands.name: GetGridElements
commands.description: Lists the grid elements (placed with the Grid Tool or created by CreateGridElements) with their position, angle, size, library part and optionally GDL parameters.

commands.name: CreateGridElements
commands.description: Creates grid elements, the elements the Grid Tool places, from begin and end coordinates, with optional story, layer and GDL parameters.

commands.name: CreateMeshes
commands.description: Creates Mesh elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateLabels
commands.description: Creates Label elements based on the given parameters, optionally on a given layer.

commands.name: CreateTexts
commands.description: Creates standalone Text elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateLevelDimensions
commands.description: Creates Level Dimension elements (the Level Dimension tool) based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateAngleDimensions
commands.description: Creates Angle Dimension elements (the Angle Dimension tool) measuring the angle between two lines, each given by two points, with the dimension arc through the given arcPosition, optionally based on an Angle Dimension favorite.

commands.name: CreateRadialDimensions
commands.description: Creates Radial Dimension elements (the Radial Dimension tool) measuring the radius of an arc, a circle or a curved wall, linked to that element, with the dimension line ending at dimensionLineEnd, optionally based on a Radial Dimension favorite, with the line pen, marker, text height, pen, position and direction, a custom text and the centre mark.

commands.name: ModifyAngleDimensions
commands.description: Changes the settings of existing Angle Dimension elements with the keys CreateAngleDimensions takes and GetDetailsOfElements returns: smallArc, the pen, and the text height and pen.

commands.name: ModifyLevelDimensions
commands.description: Changes existing Level Dimension elements: the position of the marker and the settings CreateLevelDimensions takes (pen, text height, pen, font and style, marker type and size, plus sign, angle, origin, text content (measured or custom text with Autotext keys) of both texts, and from Archicad 29 hide with associated element), with the same keys, and the static level, the Static checkbox (staticLevel) and the owner element (parentElementId, or ownerElementId as GetDetailsOfElements reads it, which does not change the Static checkbox).

commands.name: ModifyWalls
commands.description: Modifies Wall elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifyBeams
commands.description: Modifies Beam elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifySlabs
commands.description: Modifies Slab elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifyColumns
commands.description: Modifies Column elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifyWindows
commands.description: Modifies Window elements based on the given parameters: size, position, sill anchor (verticalLink), sub-floor thickness, reveal and its anchor, surface, plane in slanted walls, fix point and floor plan and section settings.

commands.name: ModifyDoors
commands.description: Modifies Door elements based on the given parameters: size, position, sill anchor (verticalLink), sub-floor thickness, reveal and its anchor, surface, plane in slanted walls, fix point and floor plan and section settings.

commands.name: ModifyOpenings
commands.description: Modifies Opening elements: the width, the height and the base point CreateOpenings takes.

commands.name: ModifyMorphs
commands.description: Modifies Morph elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifyRoofs
commands.description: Modifies single-plane and multi-plane Roof elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifyShells
commands.description: Modifies the structure (Basic or Composite, building material or composite), the thickness of Basic shells, the side of the reference surface the thickness is applied to (isFlipped), the trimming body (cutBodyType: Upward or Downward Extrusion), the clipping contour and the holes (each with its polygon, plane and depth), the top, side (edge) and bottom surface overrides, the custom surface of individual edges (edgeMaterials) and the floor plan and section settings (floor plan display, show on stories, cut fill pens, contour pens and line types, cover fill) of Shell elements, the extrusion vector or length and the profile of extruded Shells (keeping their GUID, base plane and extrusion start), the profile, axis, revolution, begin, slant and shear angles and segments of revolved Shells, and the two profiles, their planes and the morphing rule of ruled Shells (keeping their GUID and base plane), based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifyMeshes
commands.description: Modifies the attributes of Mesh elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifyRailings
commands.description: Modifies Railing elements in place: the height of all their segments, the bottom offset, the home story, the story visibility (visibility, isAutoOnStoryVisibility; Archicad 29 does not let the automatic story visibility be turned off), the pens of the reference line and the contour, and single segments (height, lateral offset) and nodes (post offset, elevation, whether the pattern continues across the node) by their index in the segments and nodes GetDetailsOfElements returns, and the top rail (visible), rails (visible, relative, horizontal offset, height) and handrails (visible, doubleHandrail, horizontal offset, height) of a segment by their index among that segment's rails and handrails, the pattern of a segment (segments[].pattern: the models of its inner posts, panels and baluster sets and its distribution, which the inner posts, panels and baluster sets the railing has then follow) and the post model of a node (nodes[].post: vertical position).

commands.name: ModifyObjects
commands.description: Modifies Object elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifyLamps
commands.description: Modifies Lamp elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifyTexts
commands.description: Modifies standalone Text elements based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifyPictures
commands.description: Modifies Picture elements: moves them to a new position, resizes them to a width and height in model units (one of them keeps the picture's proportions), changes the anchor point, the angle, mirrored, transparent and the name.

commands.name: ModifyLabels
commands.description: Modifies Label elements based on the given parameters: the text and its style, the symbol label's style, the leader line, and the leader line's coordinates, which move or re-point the label.

commands.name: ModifyCurtainWalls
commands.description: Modifies Curtain Wall elements in place, keeping their GUID, properties and classifications: the height, the bottom elevation and story, the reference line (with the same number of segments), and the column (primary) and row (secondary) pattern with its cell assignments, in the fields of CreateCurtainWalls; the side of the reference line (flipped), the panel offset from the reference line and the nominal width; and the floor plan display settings GetDetailsOfElements reads: story visibility, display option, view depth, cut, uncut and overhead projection modes, and the pens and line types of the frame and panel cut lines and of the uncut and overhead lines.

commands.name: ModifyCurtainWallFrames
commands.description: EXPERIMENTAL.

commands.name: ModifyCurtainWallPanels
commands.description: Assigns a panel class to single Curtain Wall Panels by their GUID; the panel takes the settings of the class (thickness, surfaces, building material, cut line, panel type).

commands.name: ModifyStairs
commands.description: Modifies Stair elements in place, keeping their baseline and position: the flight width, total height, number of steps, riser height and going with their locks, the top link to a story with its offset, the Rules and Standards (each limit and whether it is applied), the headroom (generation method, height and left and right offset; read back, and one Archicad did not apply is reported as an error), the finish and structure visibility, the extra top and bottom treads, the walking line position and offset, the step numbering, the walking direction, the uniform finish, monolith and draining settings, and for the flights and the landings the tread and riser settings (presence, thickness, offset, nosing, riser cross section and position) and the structure of each side (presence, type, underside shape and thickness, the monolith data of a Monolith structure: thinning, thickness, bottom oversize, building material and fill, surfaces, pens, line types and drainings, and the stringer data of a Side structure: width, height above tread and how it is measured; the monolith and stringer data are read back, and one Archicad did not apply is reported as an error), and the floor plan display: whether it is Custom or by the Model View Options, and for the floor plan and the reflected ceiling plan separately the stories the stair is shown on and whether its walking line, numbering, up/down text, description and structure are shown, the symbol on each story (above, top, middle, bottom and below the relevant stories), the break line (angle, gap and position) and the line type, pen and symbol fill overrides, and the line types, pens and fills of the structure symbols per structure type and view (structureSymbols) and of the monolithic structure per view and visible or hidden part (monolithStructureSymbols), and which structures, fills and monolithic parts are shown on each range of the relevant stories, per view (structureVisibilityOnStories); these are read back, and one Archicad did not apply is reported as an error.

commands.name: RecreateCurtainWalls
commands.description: Recreates Curtain Wall elements on a new reference line with more or fewer segments, as CreateCurtainWalls takes it, because ModifyCurtainWalls can only keep the number of segments; or with a new height or slant angle, which Archicad does not apply to an existing slanted curtain wall through ACAPI_Element_Change (seen in Archicad 29).

commands.name: RecreateRailings
commands.description: Recreates Railing elements on a new reference line - with more or fewer nodes and segments, in 2D as CreateRailings takes it or with an elevation per node and arcs as CreateRailingsFromPolyline takes it - because the Archicad API cannot change the reference line of an existing railing.

commands.name: RecreateStairs
commands.description: Recreates Stair elements on a new baseline (with its landings, winders and curved edges, as CreateStairs takes it), because the Archicad API cannot change the baseline of an existing stair.

commands.name: RecreateWindows
commands.description: Recreates Window elements in another wall (ownerWallId, optionally at a new centerOffset along it), because Archicad does not move a window into another wall through ACAPI_Element_Change: it keeps its owner (seen in Archicad 29).

commands.name: RecreateDoors
commands.description: Recreates Door elements in another wall (ownerWallId, optionally at a new centerOffset along it), because Archicad does not move a door into another wall through ACAPI_Element_Change: it keeps its owner (seen in Archicad 29).

commands.name: RecreateSkylights
commands.description: Recreates Skylight elements on another roof or shell (ownerId, optionally at a new anchorPosition on it), because Archicad does not move a skylight onto another roof or shell through ACAPI_Element_Change: it keeps its owner (seen in Archicad 29).

commands.name: RecreateZones
commands.description: Recreates automatic Zone elements as manual zones (makeManual), because Archicad does not turn an automatic zone into a manual one through ACAPI_Element_Change (seen in Archicad 29).

commands.name: RecreateAngleDimensions
commands.description: Recreates Angle Dimension elements on new lines with a new arc position (firstLine, secondLine and arcPosition, as CreateAngleDimensions takes them), because Archicad does not move the lines or the arc of an angle dimension through ACAPI_Element_Change (seen in Archicad 29).

commands.name: ChangeTextContent
commands.description: Replaces a range of the content of Text elements and text Labels, keeping the styles of the runs and the autotexts in the rest of the content.

commands.name: ModifyZones
commands.description: Modifies Zone elements: name, number, category, zone stamp, stamp pen, height, base offset, top link, floor thickness, letter size (roomLSize, in millimetres), contour line, cover fill, 3D surface (one surface on all sides, or the surfaces of the bounding walls), polygon display (gross or net) and area reduction - the same settings as CreateZones, applied by the same helpers.

commands.name: MeasureTexts
commands.description: Measures texts before placing them: the length of every line for a given font, style and height, on paper in millimetres or in the model at the current drawing scale, and the font's capital size factor.

commands.name: GetElementPreviewImage
commands.description: Returns the preview image of the given element.

commands.name: GetRoomImage
commands.description: Returns the room image of the given zone.

commands.name: GetModelExtent
commands.description: Returns the 3D extent (xMin, yMin, zMin, xMax, yMax, zMax) of the current database, the region Archicad's Fit in Window would show.

commands.name: SetElementNotificationClient
commands.description: Sets up a new notification client to receive element events.

commands.name: RemoveElementNotificationClient
commands.description: Removes an element notification client.

commands.name: RegularizePolygons
commands.description: Regularizes polygons with Archicad's own polygon regularization, before they are used to create slabs, zones or fills: removes duplicate points, fixes the orientation, resolves self-intersections and touching holes.

commands.name: RegularizePolylines
commands.description: Regularizes polylines with Archicad's own polyline regularization: removes repeated consecutive points.

commands.name: GetSplineMaxDistances
commands.description: Measures how far the given 2D coordinates are from a segment of a Spline element, between two of its fit points, with its own Bezier handles: returns the largest distance, for example to check how well a polyline follows the spline.

commands.name: GetProfileValuesOfElements
commands.description: Returns the custom profiles walls, beams and columns use, with the values the element gives them: the width and height of the stretched profile and the value of each profile modifier, measured on the stretched profile of the element (one per Profile wall, one per Profile segment of a beam or column).

commands.name: CreateGroups
commands.description: Creates groups of the passed elements

commands.name: UngroupElements
commands.description: Ungroups the given groups one level, like Edit > Grouping > Ungroup: each group is dissolved, the elements and subgroups it directly contains stay.

commands.name: GetGroupsOfElements
commands.description: Gets the identifier of the group that directly contains each given element.

commands.name: GetElementsOfGroups
commands.description: Gets the elements directly contained by each given group.

commands.name: GetMainGroups
commands.description: Gets the top level group of each given group.

commands.name: GetAllElementsOfGroups
commands.description: Gets all the elements of each given group, including the elements of its nested groups.

commands.name: GetAutoGroupMode
commands.description: Gets the current state of the Auto Group mode.

commands.name: GetElementSetData
commands.description: Gets the elements and the custom data of each given element set.

commands.name: GetUserDataOfGroups
commands.description: Gets the user data an add-on attached to each given group: its version, platform sign, flags and bytes (base64 encoded), and, when its version is 1 (the layout SetUserDataOfGroups writes), its key-value pairs.

commands.name: SetUserDataOfGroups
commands.description: Stores string values under keys in the user data of groups, for scripts to keep their own state on a group.

commands.name: GetSuspendGroupsMode
commands.description: Gets the current state of the Suspend Groups mode.

commands.name: SetSuspendGroupsMode
commands.description: Turns the Suspend Groups mode on or off.

commands.name: CreateElementSets
commands.description: Creates element sets of the given elements.

commands.name: DeleteElementSets
commands.description: Deletes the given element sets.

commands.name: GetElementSetsOfElements
commands.description: Gets the element sets that contain each given element.

commands.name: GetFavoritesByType
commands.description: Returns a list of the names of all favorites with the given element type

commands.name: GetAllFavorites
commands.description: Returns every Favorite of the project, or only those of the given element type, with its name and element type.

commands.name: GetFavoritePreviewImage
commands.description: Returns the preview image of the given favorite.

commands.name: GetFavoriteDetails
commands.description: Returns the classifications, property values and element category values stored in the given favorites, so they can be audited before elements are placed.

commands.name: ApplyFavoritesToElementDefaults
commands.description: Apply the given favorites to element defaults.

commands.name: CreateFavoritesFromElements
commands.description: Create favorites from the given elements.

commands.name: ImportFavorites
commands.description: Import Favorites from a .prefs file or folder into the current project.

commands.name: ExportFavorites
commands.description: Export the project's Favorites to a .prefs file or folder.

commands.name: ApplyFavoritesToElements
commands.description: Apply the given favorites to existing elements.

commands.name: UpdateFavoritesFromElements
commands.description: Update existing favorites from the given elements.

commands.name: RenameFavorites
commands.description: Rename existing favorites.

commands.name: DeleteFavorites
commands.description: Delete existing favorites.

commands.name: GetFavoriteFolders
commands.description: Returns the folder tree of the Favorites palette from its root folder: the name and path of every folder and the names of the Favorites in it.

commands.name: ReadFavoritesFile
commands.description: Read the Favorites of a .prefs file or folder without importing them, returning the name, element type and folder of each.

commands.name: CreateFavoriteFolder
commands.description: Creates a folder in the Favorites palette, in the parent folder given by its path.

commands.name: RenameFavoriteFolder
commands.description: Renames a folder of the Favorites palette given by its path.

commands.name: DeleteFavoriteFolder
commands.description: Deletes a folder of the Favorites palette given by its path.

commands.name: GetFavoriteSettings
commands.description: Reads the stored settings of the given favorites without applying them or placing an element: the element type, the folder, the library part and GDL parameters, the marker (library part and parameters) of Window and Door favorites, and the sub-elements.

commands.name: CreateFavorite
commands.description: Creates a Favorite in the given folder from the settings of another Favorite or of the current Opening tool default. conflictPolicy says what happens when the name is taken: fail, skip, overwrite the existing Favorite's settings or create the new one under a free name.

commands.name: ChangeFavorite
commands.description: Gives an existing Favorite the settings of another Favorite or of the current Opening tool default.

commands.name: ApplyFavoriteToToolDefault
commands.description: Makes the settings of the given Favorite the settings of its tool, and returns the element type of that tool.

commands.name: MoveFavoriteFolder
commands.description: Moves a folder of the Favorites palette, with its Favorites and subfolders, into another folder.

commands.name: GetFavoriteContents
commands.description: Returns the Favorites of a folder of the Favorites palette and of its subfolders (every Favorite when no folder is given), each with its folder path, classifications, element category values and property values, read through the Favorite manager.

commands.name: DeleteFavoritesWithManager
commands.description: Deletes the given Favorites through the Favorite manager, each found by name, optionally only in the given folder.

commands.name: MoveFavorites
commands.description: Moves Favorites given by their names into a folder of the Favorites palette given by its path.

commands.name: GetFavoriteDefaults
commands.description: Reads the element default stored in each given Favorite through the Favorite manager, without applying it or placing an element: the element type, the layer, the element ID, the folder, the library part and GDL parameters, the marker of every element type that has one, and the sub-elements with each of their kinds (Curtain Wall frames and panels, Stair treads and risers, Railing posts and rails, markers ...).

commands.name: SearchFavorites
commands.description: Searches project favorites by keyword (matching favorite name or folder) and/or element type.

commands.name: GetAllProperties
commands.description: Returns all user defined and built-in properties.

commands.name: SearchProperties
commands.description: Searches properties by name or group substring with optional filtering by property type, value type, and collection type.

commands.name: GetPropertyValuesOfElements
commands.description: Returns the property values of the elements for the given property.

commands.name: GetTypedPropertyValuesOfElements
commands.description: Returns the property values of the elements in JSON's own types instead of display text: numbers, integers, booleans, strings, lists of them, and the chosen options of an option set as their identifiers (a list for a multiple choice).

commands.name: SetPropertyValuesOfElements
commands.description: Sets the property values of elements.

commands.name: GetComponentsOfElements
commands.description: Returns the components of the elements: the building material skins of composite walls, slabs, roofs and shells, and the parts of complex profile walls, beams and columns.

commands.name: GetPropertyDefinitionsOfElementComponents
commands.description: Returns the property definitions available on the given element components, optionally filtered to user defined or built-in ones.

commands.name: GetPropertyValuesOfElementComponents
commands.description: Returns the property values of the given element components for the given properties, in the shape of GetPropertyValuesOfElements.

commands.name: SetPropertyValuesOfElementDefaults
commands.description: Sets the property values of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of element types, so every element placed afterwards gets them, without saving and applying a favorite.

commands.name: GetPropertyValuesOfAttributes
commands.description: Returns the property values of the attributes for the given property.

commands.name: SetPropertyValuesOfAttributes
commands.description: Sets the property values of attributes.

commands.name: SetBuiltInPropertyValuesOfAttributes
commands.description: Sets built-in property values of attributes, writing the values of each attribute together.

commands.name: SetPropertyValueOfAttributes
commands.description: Sets one property value on several attributes (for example Building Materials) in one undo step.

commands.name: GetPropertyDefinitionsOfAttributes
commands.description: Returns the property definitions of the given attributes (for example Building Materials): the user defined, the fundamental built-in, or all of them.

commands.name: GetPropertiesOfToolDefaults
commands.description: Returns the property definitions of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of the given element types, filtered by kind (all by default), and optionally the value of each property in the tool default.

commands.name: AddPropertyToAttributes
commands.description: Makes an existing custom property available for the given attributes (for example Building Materials), in one undo step.

commands.name: RemovePropertyFromAttributes
commands.description: Makes a custom property unavailable for the given attributes (for example Building Materials), in one undo step.

commands.name: CreatePropertyGroups
commands.description: Creates Property Groups based on the given parameters.

commands.name: DeletePropertyGroups
commands.description: Deletes the given Custom Property Groups.

commands.name: CreatePropertyDefinitions
commands.description: Creates Custom Property Definitions based on the given parameters.

commands.name: DeletePropertyDefinitions
commands.description: Deletes the given Custom Property Definitions.

commands.name: UpdatePropertyDefinitions
commands.description: Updates existing Custom Property Definitions in place, keeping their guid: name, description, group, default value or expressions, availability, and enum options (add, rename, remove, reorder).

commands.name: UpdatePropertyGroups
commands.description: Updates the name and/or description of existing Custom Property Groups, keeping their guid.

commands.name: ImportPropertiesXml
commands.description: Imports a Property Manager XML export, with the given policy for names that already exist.

commands.name: GetPropertyValuesOfElementDefaults
commands.description: Returns the values of the given properties in the current tool default of an element type, which new elements of that type get.

commands.name: ModifyPropertyValueOfElements
commands.description: Sets one property value on all the given elements in a single step.

commands.name: GetPropertyExpressionReferences
commands.description: Returns the strings that refer to the given properties in property expressions.

commands.name: CheckPropertyValues
commands.description: Checks whether the given values are acceptable for the given property definitions, without changing anything.

commands.name: GetPropertyEditability
commands.description: Tells whether the values of the given properties can be modified, and whether the properties are visible, for the given elements.

commands.name: GetPropertyAvailabilityOfDefaults
commands.description: Tells whether the given properties are available and whether they are visible in the current tool default of an element type, before creating new elements.
