commands.name: MakePropertyAvailableForElements
commands.description: Makes a property definition available for all the given elements.

commands.name: MakePropertyUnavailableForElements
commands.description: Makes a property definition unavailable for all the given elements.

commands.name: GetClassificationsOfElements
commands.description: Returns the classification of the given elements in the given classification systems.

commands.name: GetElementsByClassification
commands.description: Returns the elements classified with the given classification items, one list per item, so elements can be filtered by classification in a single call.

commands.name: SetClassificationsOfElements
commands.description: Sets the classifications of elements.

commands.name: GetClassificationsOfAttributes
commands.description: Returns the classifications of the given attributes (building materials, composites, surfaces, etc.) in every classification system they are classified in.

commands.name: SetClassificationsOfAttributes
commands.description: Sets the classifications of attributes (building materials, composites, surfaces, etc.).

commands.name: GetClassificationOfAttributesInSystem
commands.description: Returns the classification of the given attributes (for example Building Materials) in the given classification system. classificationItemId is omitted for an unclassified attribute.

commands.name: GetClassificationsOfElementDefaults
commands.description: Returns the classification of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of the given element types in the given classification systems.

commands.name: SetClassificationsOfElementDefaults
commands.description: Sets the classifications of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of the given element types.

commands.name: GetClassificationsOfToolDefaults
commands.description: Returns every classification of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of the given element types, in all classification systems at once.

commands.name: GetAllClassificationSystems
commands.description: Returns the classification systems of the project with their guid, name, description, source, version and date.

commands.name: CreateClassificationSystems
commands.description: Creates Classification Systems including Classification Items based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateClassificationItems
commands.description: Creates Classification Items in the given Classification Systems based on the given parameters.

commands.name: DeleteClassificationSystems
commands.description: Deletes the given Classification Systems.

commands.name: DeleteClassificationItems
commands.description: Deletes the given Classification Items.

commands.name: UpdateClassificationSystems
commands.description: Updates the name, description, source, version and/or date of existing Classification Systems, keeping their guid.

commands.name: UpdateClassificationItems
commands.description: Updates the id (code), name and/or description of existing Classification Items, keeping their guid and so the elements classified with them.

commands.name: GetClassificationItemParents
commands.description: Returns the parent item and the classification system of the given Classification Items; a top level item has no parent.

commands.name: ImportClassificationsXml
commands.description: Imports a Classification Manager XML export, with the given policies for systems and items that already exist.

commands.name: GetClassificationItemVisibility
commands.description: Tells whether the given classification items are visible (offered) for the given elements, element tool defaults and attributes, such as building materials.

commands.name: GetAttributesByType
commands.description: Returns the details of every attribute of the given type, including the path of the attribute folder holding it (Archicad 26 and newer).

commands.name: GetAttributeIndexes
commands.description: Reports for each given attribute type how many attributes there are, the first valid and the highest index in use, and the free indexes between them (for example those of deleted attributes).

commands.name: GetAttributesFromProject
commands.description: Reads the attributes of the given types from another project or template file without opening it, for example to compare them with the attributes of the open project.

commands.name: DeleteAttributes
commands.description: Deletes the given attributes.

commands.name: ImportAttributesFromProject
commands.description: Imports Line, Fill, ZoneCategory, PenTable, OperationProfile, Composite, Profile and LayerCombination attributes from another project or template file into the open project, with their complete definition (symbol and percent fills included), like Append or Overwrite by name in Archicad's Attribute Manager.

commands.name: GetUsedAttributes
commands.description: Gets how many attributes of each type are in use (layers, lines, fills, composites, surfaces, ...), as Archicad reports them for the usedAttributes JSON query: the counts in usedAttributes, the report as text in raw.

commands.name: ConsolidateLines
commands.description: Runs the Line Consolidation menu command of Archicad on the current window, as the menu does, and reports whether it ran together with what Archicad answered.

commands.name: ConsolidateFills
commands.description: Runs the Fill Consolidation menu command of Archicad on the current window, as the menu does, and reports whether it ran together with what Archicad answered.

commands.name: CreateAttributeFolders
commands.description: Creates attribute folders, each given by attribute type and path (the folder names from the root folder down).

commands.name: DeleteAttributeFolders
commands.description: Deletes attribute folders, each given by attribute type and path, together with all the subfolders and deletable attributes they contain (a folder holding an attribute that cannot be deleted is kept).

commands.name: RenameAttributeFolders
commands.description: Renames attribute folders, each given by attribute type and path, to the given new names.

commands.name: MoveAttributesAndFolders
commands.description: Moves attributes and attribute folders (with their contents) into the target folder, which must be of the same attribute type; an empty target path is the root folder.

commands.name: ReindexLayers
commands.description: Moves layers to new indices.

commands.name: ReindexAttributes
commands.description: Moves fills, line types, surfaces, building materials and zone categories to new indices, the way ReindexLayers moves layers.

commands.name: DeleteAndReplaceAttributes
commands.description: Deletes fills, line types, surfaces, building materials, profiles, zone categories or layers and replaces each by another attribute of the same type wherever it was used, like Delete and Replace in the Attribute Manager.

commands.name: GetUnusedAttributes
commands.description: Lists the unused layers, fills, surfaces, building materials, composites, profiles, line types, pen tables and zone categories (index, id and name), for the given types or all of them.

commands.name: GetMissingAttributes
commands.description: Lists the references of placed elements to layers, fills, surfaces, building materials, composites, profiles, line types, pen tables and zone categories that do not exist in the project, for the given types or all of them, and of the tool defaults, Favorites, graphic override rules, Model View Options combinations and attributes: the structured counterpart of the missing attributes report of Archicad's GDL palette.

commands.name: CreateLayers
commands.description: Creates or overwrites Layer attributes based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateLayerCombinations
commands.description: Creates or overwrites Layer Combination attributes based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateLines
commands.description: Creates or overwrites Line attributes based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateFills
commands.description: Creates or overwrites Fill attributes based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateZoneCategories
commands.description: Creates or overwrites Zone Category attributes based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateMEPSystems
commands.description: Creates or overwrites MEP System attributes (domain, pens, fill, center line type, surface and insulation surface) based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreatePenTables
commands.description: Creates or overwrites Pen Table attributes based on the given parameters.

commands.name: ModifyPens
commands.description: Changes the color, width and description of single pens of the Pen Table in effect for the model views (the default) or the layouts, keeping every other pen as it is.

commands.name: CreateProfiles
commands.description: Creates or overwrites Profile attributes as a copy of an existing Profile's geometry, based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateBuildingMaterials
commands.description: Creates or overwrites Building Material attributes based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateComposites
commands.description: Creates or overwrites Composite attributes based on the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateSurfaces
commands.description: Creates or overwrites Surface attributes based on the given parameters.

commands.name: GetBuildingMaterialPhysicalProperties
commands.description: Retrieves the physical properties of the given Building Materials.

commands.name: GetLayerCombinations
commands.description: Returns the details of layer combination attributes.

commands.name: GetCurrentLayerCombination
commands.description: Returns the layer combination in effect in the current window.

commands.name: ActivateLayerCombination
commands.description: Activates the given layer combination in the current window, like choosing it in the Quick Layers palette.

commands.name: GetLayerOfElementDefaults
commands.description: Returns the layer of the tool defaults of the given element types: the layer new elements of that type are placed on.

commands.name: SetLayerOfElementDefaults
commands.description: Sets the layer of the tool defaults of the given element types, so new elements of that type are placed on it.

commands.name: RenameAttributes
commands.description: Renames attributes of any type (layers, layer combinations, composites, surfaces, ...).

commands.name: ModifyLayers
commands.description: Changes the given settings of existing layers: shown or hidden, locked, wireframe, the intersection group and the name.

commands.name: GetLines
commands.description: Returns the details of the given Line attributes.

commands.name: GetFills
commands.description: Returns the details of the given Fill attributes.

commands.name: GetZoneCategories
commands.description: Returns the details of the given Zone Category attributes.

commands.name: GetMEPSystems
commands.description: Returns the details of the given MEP System attributes (domain, pens, fill, center line type, surface and insulation surface).

commands.name: GetPenTables
commands.description: Returns the details of the given Pen Table attributes.

commands.name: GetCurrentPenTable
commands.description: Returns the current Pen Table (its index, attribute identifier and name) and its number of pens.

commands.name: GetPens
commands.description: Returns the given pens, or all of them, in effect in the current window: index, color, width and description.

commands.name: SetPens
commands.description: Changes the color, width and description of the given pens in effect in the current window, the pens GetPens returns, in one undo step.

commands.name: GetProfiles
commands.description: Returns the details of the given Profile attributes.

commands.name: GetComposites
commands.description: Returns the details of the given Composite attributes.

commands.name: GetSurfaces
commands.description: Returns the details of the given Surface attributes.

commands.name: GetLayers
commands.description: Returns the details of the given Layer attributes.

commands.name: GetBuildingMaterials
commands.description: Returns the details of the given Building Material attributes.

commands.name: GetFontsByName
commands.description: Finds loaded fonts by name through Archicad's font search and returns their index (as Text and Label fields reference fonts in fontIndex) and name, or an error for a name no loaded font has.

commands.name: GetGraphicOverrideRules
commands.description: Gets all graphic override rules of the project, with their rule group, criterion and style.

commands.name: GetGraphicOverrideRulesByName
commands.description: Gets graphic override rules by name, with their rule group, criterion and style.

commands.name: CreateGraphicOverrideRules
commands.description: Creates graphic override rules.

commands.name: ModifyGraphicOverrideRules
commands.description: Modifies the name, criterion or style of graphic override rules.

commands.name: DeleteGraphicOverrideRules
commands.description: Deletes graphic override rules.

commands.name: GetGraphicOverrideCombinations
commands.description: Gets all graphic override combinations of the project with the rules they contain.

commands.name: CreateGraphicOverrideCombinations
commands.description: Creates graphic override combinations from existing rules.

commands.name: ModifyGraphicOverrideCombinations
commands.description: Modifies the name and/or the rules of graphic override combinations.

commands.name: DeleteGraphicOverrideCombinations
commands.description: Deletes graphic override combinations.

commands.name: CreateGraphicOverrideRuleGroups
commands.description: Creates empty graphic override rule groups.

commands.name: GetGraphicOverrideRuleGroups
commands.description: Gets all graphic override rule groups of the project with the rules they contain, empty groups included.

commands.name: SetGraphicOverrideRuleOrder
commands.description: Sets the order of the rules in graphic override rule groups, found by name.

commands.name: RenameGraphicOverrideRuleGroups
commands.description: Renames graphic override rule groups, found by name.

commands.name: DeleteGraphicOverrideRuleGroups
commands.description: Deletes graphic override rule groups, found by name.

commands.name: SetGraphicOverrideRuleGroupOrder
commands.description: Sets the order of the graphic override rule groups, found by name.

commands.name: MoveGraphicOverrideRules
commands.description: Moves graphic override rules to another rule group, or to another place in their own group.

commands.name: GetUserDataOfAttributes
commands.description: Reads the key-value pairs stored on attributes by SetUserDataOfAttributes.

commands.name: SetUserDataOfAttributes
commands.description: Stores string values under keys in the user data of attributes, for scripts to keep their own state on an attribute.

commands.name: DeleteUserDataOfAttributes
commands.description: Removes the user data of attributes, every key at once.

commands.name: IFCFileOperation
commands.description: Executes an IFC file operation: opens or merges an IFC file, or saves the project as an IFC file.

commands.name: GetIFCExportTranslators
commands.description: Lists the IFC export translators of the project in the order of Archicad's translator list. preview marks the first one, which the Archicad API documents as the preview translator; no API identifies the preview translator otherwise, and in some projects the IFC Translators dialog shows another one as preview.

commands.name: GetElementsByIFCIds
commands.description: Retrieves the elements by the given IFC identifiers.

commands.name: GetIFCIdsOfElements
commands.description: Retrieves the IFC identifiers of the given elements.

commands.name: GetIFCTypeOfElements
commands.description: Retrieves the IFC types of the given elements.

commands.name: GetIFCPropertiesOfElements
commands.description: Retrieves the IFC properties of the given elements.

commands.name: GetIFCAttributesOfElements
commands.description: Retrieves the IFC attributes (Name, Description, ObjectType, Tag, PredefinedType, LongName, ...) of the given elements, subelements included: the name, the IFC value type and the value of each attribute.

commands.name: SetIFCAttributesOfElements
commands.description: Sets the values of IFC attributes (Name, Description, ObjectType, Tag, ...) of elements.

commands.name: SetIFCPropertiesOfElements
commands.description: Sets local IFC properties on elements by creating or modifying single value (IfcPropertySingleValue) properties in the given property sets.

commands.name: GetIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements
commands.description: Retrieves the IFC classification references of the given elements, subelements included: identification, name, location, description and sort (from Archicad 29), the name of the IfcRelAssociatesClassification (from Archicad 28), the referenced classification (name, source, edition, edition date, description and location) and whether the reference comes from the preview translator or is stored locally.

commands.name: SetIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements
commands.description: Stores IFC classification references (identification, name, location and the referenced classification with its name, edition, edition date, description and location) on elements.

commands.name: RemoveIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements
commands.description: Removes IFC classification references stored on elements, given by the name of their classification and optionally their identification; without identification every stored reference of that classification is removed.

commands.name: RemoveIFCPropertiesOfElements
commands.description: Removes local IFC properties, given by property set and property name, from elements.

commands.name: GetIFCSpatialStructure
commands.description: Returns the IfcProject, IfcSite and IfcBuilding objects of the project's IFC model (hash value, IFC type and GlobalId), and for the given elements the index of the story they are assigned to in the IFC model.

commands.name: GetIFCAssignments
commands.description: Returns the IFC assignments of the project: the root IFC groups, and for each object the objects assigned to it (children) and the objects it is assigned to (parents).

commands.name: GetLibraries
commands.description: Gets the list of loaded libraries.

commands.name: ReloadLibraries
commands.description: Executes the reload libraries command.

commands.name: AddFilesToEmbeddedLibrary
commands.description: Adds the given files into the embedded library.

commands.name: DeleteEmbeddedLibraryItems
commands.description: Deletes the given items from the embedded library.

commands.name: CreateLibraryParts
commands.description: Creates GDL library parts in the embedded library from their scripts (master, 2D, 3D, parameter, interface, properties) and parameter definitions, under the given parent subtype.

commands.name: CreateFolderInEmbeddedLibrary
commands.description: Creates a folder, with any missing parent folders, inside the embedded library.

commands.name: CopyFilesIntoEmbeddedLibrary
commands.description: Copies the given files, keeping their names, into a folder of the embedded library with one library operation.

commands.name: SetLibraries
commands.description: Makes the given folders the project's local libraries; built-in, embedded, server and web libraries are kept.

commands.name: AddLibraries
commands.description: Adds the given folders to the project's local libraries, skipping any already loaded.

commands.name: GetAvailableLibraryParts
commands.description: Lists library parts currently available to the project.

commands.name: GetLibraryPartSections
commands.description: Lists the sections of library parts given by index: their four-character type code, sub-identifier, size and whether they are text (scripts, comments) or binary (previews).

commands.name: GetLibraryPartSection
commands.description: Reads the text of a text section (a script or the comment) of a library part given by index, without opening it in the GDL editor.

commands.name: GetLibrariesOfLibParts
commands.description: Gets the library of each given library part (by file name or guid): display name, location, embedded/built-in/package/local/missing flags and the Library Manager tree path.

commands.name: GetLibraryPartTypeDetails
commands.description: Returns the type details of the given library parts (ACAPI_LibraryPart_GetDetails): full unique ID and its direct parent's, type, the detail flags of objects, lamps, labels and zones, the frame and orientation settings of doors and windows, and the element type and variation of the tool that places the library part.

commands.name: IsLibraryPartSubtypeOf
commands.description: Checks for each of the given library parts whether the given ancestor is anywhere up its subtype hierarchy (e.g. whether a part is a kind of furniture), independent of its name.

commands.name: GetGDLParametersOfLibraryParts
commands.description: Gets the default GDL parameters (name, display name, type, array dimensions, value, flags) of the given library parts by name, read from the library part without placing it or changing any defaults.

commands.name: GetMissingLibPartNames
commands.description: Gets the library part name of the given placed Object, Lamp, Window or Door elements, even if the library containing the part is not loaded.

commands.name: GetUnusedLibraryParts
commands.description: Lists the loaded library parts that no element of the project is placed from.

commands.name: FindLibraryParts
commands.description: Finds loaded library parts with the Library Manager: all of them, GDL objects, images or text files, optionally only those whose name contains a text.

commands.name: GetLibraryPartDetails
commands.description: Gets the details of loaded library parts, by name or index: path, library tree path, containing library, and for GDL objects the GUID, subtype, license, UI default flag, which scripts and pictures they have, and optionally the interface and migration scripts.

commands.name: ModifyLibraryList
commands.description: Adds libraries by path and removes loaded libraries by name or path, in one change of the library list.

commands.name: GetLibraryPartMetadata
commands.description: Returns the description, keywords, author and placeable, password protected and hierarchical pages flags of loaded library parts, given by file name.

commands.name: GetLibraryPartOriginalLocations
commands.description: Gets the original location of the given library parts, the file they came from, e.g. before they were embedded into the project.

commands.name: IsUsableGDLString
commands.description: Checks whether each of the given strings is usable in GDL, e.g. before writing it into a GDL parameter or script.

commands.name: GetGDLDate
commands.description: Gets the date GDL scripts see: year, month, day, hour, minute and second.

commands.name: SetGDLDate
commands.description: Sets the date GDL scripts see: year, month, day, hour, minute and second, as GetGDLDate returns them.

commands.name: CheckLibraries
commands.description: Checks the loaded libraries with the Archicad API's library check.

commands.name: ResetLibraries
commands.description: Resets the loaded libraries with the Archicad API's library reset.

commands.name: SetLibraryPartScripts
commands.description: Sets and deletes the master, parameter, 2D, 3D, properties, interface and forward and backward migration scripts of loaded library parts.

commands.name: SetLibraryPartMetadata
commands.description: Sets the author, keywords, license, license version, password and the placeable, UI default, subtype and hierarchical pages flags of loaded library parts.

commands.name: GetLibraryPartPictures
commands.description: Gets the preview picture and the GDL pictures of a loaded library part as base64 encoded PNGs, and from Archicad 29 also their dark user interface variants.

commands.name: SetLibraryPartPictures
commands.description: Deletes the preview picture, the GDL pictures (and from Archicad 29 their dark variants) or the 2D symbol of a loaded library part, or copies the 2D symbol from another library part.

commands.name: GetLibraryPartCustomSection
commands.description: Gets a custom section of a loaded library part by its section identifier and index: whether it exists, its data version and its content as base64.

commands.name: SetLibraryPartCustomSection
commands.description: Creates, replaces or deletes a custom section of a loaded library part.

commands.name: CreateLibraryPart
commands.description: Creates a new library part file (.gsm) of the given loaded subtype, inheriting its parameters, and reports whether it is loaded with its index and names.

commands.name: GetLibraryPartParameterValues
commands.description: Returns the parameters of loaded library parts, given by their file name as GetAvailableLibraryParts returns it, with their default values and descriptions, in the format of GetGDLParametersOfElements: the read counterpart of SetLibraryPartParameters.

commands.name: UpdateLibraryPartSections
commands.description: Replaces the text of existing sections (scripts, comment, keywords, copyright) of a loaded library part, found by its name.

commands.name: GetLibraryPart2DPrimitives
commands.description: Gets the lines, arcs and polygons (with their holes, and whether they are fills) of the 2D symbol of a loaded library part, drawn with its default parameters or with the parameters of a placed instance.

commands.name: SetLibraryPartPictureImages
commands.description: Sets the preview picture and the GDL pictures of a loaded library part from base64 encoded PNGs, and from Archicad 29 also their dark user interface variants.

commands.name: SetLibraryPartParameters
commands.description: Sets the parameter values, and optionally the parameter descriptions, of loaded library parts, in the format of SetGDLParametersOfElements.

commands.name: GetLibraryPartScripts
commands.description: Gets the master, parameter, 2D, 3D and properties scripts of loaded library parts, given by name or by an element placed from them, with the unique ID of each part.

commands.name: GetLibraryPartFileInfo
commands.description: Reads library part files (.gsm) without loading them into the libraries of the project: the unique ID of the part, the unique ID of its subtype, its master, parameter, 2D, 3D and properties scripts, and, with includeParameters, its parameters with their default values and descriptions (in the format of GetLibraryPartParameterValues).

commands.name: CopyLibraryParts
commands.description: Copies loaded library parts, given by name or by an element placed from them, under a new file name into a folder, by default the embedded library.

commands.name: GetLibraryPartIdentities
commands.description: Gets the unique ID (main and revision GUID), the reference GUID and the Teamwork lock status of library parts given by index or file path, and whether they are in a server library.

commands.name: CompareLibraryPartUnIds
commands.description: Compares two library part unique IDs with Archicad's own comparison and tells whether their main and revision GUIDs are the same.

commands.name: GetLastValidEmbeddedLibraryPartName
commands.description: Gets the name and file path of the last valid library part of the embedded library.

commands.name: SearchLibraryParts
commands.description: Finds the loaded library parts derived from an ancestor library part (by its unique ID) whose name matches a pattern with * wildcards.

commands.name: OpenLibraryPartInEditor
commands.description: Opens a loaded library part, given by its fileName or documentName as returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts, in Archicad's library part editor.

commands.name: CreateLibraryPartFromElements
commands.description: Creates a library part in the embedded library (or in a given local library folder, which is added to the loaded libraries when needed) whose 2D symbol is a copy of the given 2D drawing elements (lines, polylines, arcs, circles, splines, fills, texts and hotspots), under the given parent subtype, with optional master, 2D, 3D and parameter scripts, comment and keywords.

commands.name: InterpretGDLScript3D
commands.description: Runs a GDL 3D script, given as text or as the master and 3D scripts of a loaded library part with its default parameters, with the settings of the GDL editor, and returns whether it ran without a GDL error, how many 3D model elements it generated and their bounding box.

commands.name: GetGDLUserGlobals
commands.description: Returns the current GDL global variables the GDL interpreter gets, with their names, types and values.

commands.name: TeamworkSend
commands.description: Performs a send operation on the currently opened Teamwork project.

commands.name: TeamworkReceive
commands.description: Performs a receive operation on the currently opened Teamwork project.

commands.name: GetTeamworkProjectInfo
commands.description: Tells whether the opened project is a Teamwork project and whether it is online, and returns its BIMcloud server, project name and the current user (id and name).

commands.name: ReserveElements
commands.description: Reserves elements in Teamwork mode.

commands.name: ReleaseElements
commands.description: Releases elements in Teamwork mode.

commands.name: GetReservationStatusOfElements
commands.description: Returns the Teamwork reservation status of elements without reserving them: whether each element is free, reserved by the current user or reserved by another user, with the reserving user.

commands.name: GrantElements
commands.description: Hands over the reservation of elements to another Teamwork user, given by user id, without a dialog.

commands.name: ReserveLockableObjectSet
commands.description: Reserves a non-element lockable object set (attributes, favorites, project info, project preferences, etc.) in Teamwork mode.

commands.name: ReleaseLockableObjectSet
commands.description: Releases a non-element lockable object set reserved with ReserveLockableObjectSet in Teamwork mode.

commands.name: GetLockableObjectSetStatus
commands.description: Returns the Teamwork reservation status of a non-element lockable object set and the users who hold it.

commands.name: ReserveHotlinkCacheManagement
commands.description: Reserves the Hotlink and XRef management in Teamwork mode, which is needed before changing hotlink nodes.

commands.name: ReleaseHotlinkCacheManagement
commands.description: Releases the Hotlink and XRef management in Teamwork mode.

commands.name: GetTeamworkStatus
commands.description: Returns whether the opened project is a Teamwork project and is online, the members of the shared project and who has reserved the Hotlink and XRef management.

commands.name: GetTeamworkOwnersOfDatabases
commands.description: Returns the Teamwork owner (user id and name) of each given database, e.g. of a layout or a view database.

commands.name: UploadLibrariesToBIMcloud
commands.description: Uploads local library folders or container files (.lcf) to a folder of a BIMcloud or Teamwork server, as BIMcloud libraries.

commands.name: RemoveLibrariesFromBIMcloud
commands.description: Removes libraries, given by name, from a folder of a BIMcloud or Teamwork server.

commands.name: GetTeamworkRightsOfObjects
commands.description: Returns for each given object, for example an element, whether the current Teamwork user has the right to create objects of its kind and to delete or modify it.

commands.name: GetTeamworkAccessRights
commands.description: Returns whether the role of the current user has the given Teamwork access rights (API_TWAccessRights names without the API prefix, e.g. LayersCreate), all of them when no names are given.

commands.name: PublishPublisherSet
commands.description: Performs a publish operation on the currently opened project.

commands.name: GetPublisherSets
commands.description: Returns the publisher sets of the project with their saved output: the local or LAN path, the Teamwork file server path, or the Internet host and directory name.

commands.name: UpdateDrawings
commands.description: Performs a drawing update on the given elements.

commands.name: GetDrawingContentBoxes
commands.description: Returns the full content box of the given Drawing elements, independent of their frames, as ACAPI_Drawing_GetFullDrawingContentBox reports it.

commands.name: GetDatabaseIdFromNavigatorItemId
commands.description: Gets the ID of the database associated with the supplied navigator item id

commands.name: GetDatabases
commands.description: Lists every database of the given types (sections, elevations, interior elevations, details, worksheets, 3D documents, layouts, master layouts) with its database ID, name and reference ID, without walking the navigator trees.

commands.name: CreateDetails
commands.description: Creates independent Detail databases.

commands.name: CreateWorksheets
commands.description: Creates independent Worksheet databases.

commands.name: Create3DDocuments
commands.description: Creates 3D Documents with the given names and reference IDs, in the Project Map's 3D Documents folder.

commands.name: CreateDetailMarkers
commands.description: Places Detail markers with their clip polygon in the current floor plan, section or elevation, each with a new Detail viewpoint, like the Detail tool.

commands.name: CreateWorksheetMarkers
commands.description: Places Worksheet markers with their clip polygon in the current floor plan, section or elevation, each with a new Worksheet viewpoint, like the Worksheet tool.

commands.name: ModifyDetailMarkers
commands.description: Changes the name, the reference ID, the clip polygon, the boundary's pen and line type, the marker symbol's angle, always-horizontal setting and pen, and 'Copy construction elements only' of Detail and Worksheet markers.

commands.name: CreateLayout
commands.description: Creates Layouts and their backing master layouts.

commands.name: CreateLayoutSubset
commands.description: Creates Layout Book subsets.

commands.name: GetLayoutSubsetSettings
commands.description: Gets the settings of existing Layout Book subsets: the same fields CreateLayoutSubset accepts (name, ID prefix, numbering style, ...).

commands.name: ChangeLayoutSubsetSettings
commands.description: Changes the settings of existing Layout Book subsets (name, ID prefix, numbering style, start at, ...), the fields of CreateLayoutSubset; the ones not given keep their value.

commands.name: CreateDrawings
commands.description: Creates Drawing elements on the specified or active layout from navigator items.

commands.name: ChangeDrawingLink
commands.description: Relinks a Drawing to a different source navigator item.

commands.name: GetLayoutSettings
commands.description: Gets settings of layouts, including their master layout and Layout Info Panel custom data fields.

commands.name: SetLayoutSettings
commands.description: Sets settings of layouts, including their master layout and Layout Info Panel custom data fields.

commands.name: GetLayoutCustomScheme
commands.description: Gets the Layout Info Panel custom field definitions (name and key) from Book Settings.

commands.name: GetDrawingNumberingGridLines
commands.description: Gets the lines of the grid of the grid-based drawing numbering of the current layout (start and end point, pen index, line type index), for example to find which grid cell a drawing on the layout sits in.

commands.name: GetModelViewOptions
commands.description: Gets all model view options

commands.name: FindModelViewOption
commands.description: Finds a model view option combination by id or by name and returns its index, id, name and flags.

commands.name: GetModelViewOptionDetails
commands.description: Gets the settings stored in model view option combinations (Document > Model View > Model View Options), all of them or the ones given by id or by name: the model view options in the fields of GetViewOptions, and the options library parts add to the combination (gdlOptions) with their GDL parameter values.

commands.name: GetViewOptions
commands.description: Gets the model view options and on-screen view options of the current plan window, and the index and name of the model view option combination it applies.

commands.name: SetViewOptions
commands.description: Switches the current plan window to a model view option combination by index, and/or changes the given model view options and on-screen view options.

commands.name: GetViewSettings
commands.description: Gets the view settings of navigator items

commands.name: SetViewSettings
commands.description: Sets the view settings of navigator items

commands.name: GetActiveGraphicalOverrideCombination
commands.description: Gets the graphic override combination applied to the current window, with its id and name.

commands.name: SetActiveGraphicalOverrideCombination
commands.description: Applies a graphic override combination, given by id or by name, to the current window.

commands.name: GetRenovationFilters
commands.description: Gets the renovation filters of the project, and the one the current window uses (Document > Renovation > Renovation Filter).

commands.name: SetActiveRenovationFilter
commands.description: Sets the renovation filter of the current window (Document > Renovation > Renovation Filter), given by its renovationFilterId from GetRenovationFilters or by its name.

commands.name: GetGhostStorySettings
commands.description: Gets the Trace & Reference ghost story settings of the floor plan: whether it is on, whether one story, the story above or the one below is shown, which story, its color and the element types shown in it.

commands.name: SetGhostStorySettings
commands.description: Sets the Trace & Reference ghost story settings of the floor plan through its ghost record, which is created when the floor plan has none.

commands.name: GetStructureDisplay
commands.description: Gets the Partial Structure Display (EntireStructure, CoreOnly, WithoutFinishes or StructureOnly) of the current window, and whether it is the 3D window.

commands.name: SetStructureDisplay
commands.description: Sets the Partial Structure Display (EntireStructure, CoreOnly, WithoutFinishes or StructureOnly) of the current window, e.g. the floor plan, a section or the 3D window.

commands.name: GetView2DTransformations
commands.description: Get zoom and rotation of 2D views

commands.name: SetViewRotation
commands.description: Set the rotation angle of 2D views via their floor plan database.

commands.name: CloneProjectMapItemToViewMap
commands.description: Clones Project Map viewpoints into a specified View Map folder.

commands.name: CreateViewsInViewMap
commands.description: Creates independent (non-clone) navigator views in a specified View Map folder, by copying database and settings from source items.

commands.name: CreateViewMapFolder
commands.description: Creates a new folder in the View Map.

commands.name: Set3DCutPlanes
commands.description: Sets the 3D cut planes (pa*x + pb*y + pc*z = pd, cutting away the side the normal points to), with the pen and surface of their cut faces, and turns 3D Cutaway on.

commands.name: Get3DCutPlanes
commands.description: Gets whether the 3D cut planes are on, the cut planes (pa, pb, pc, pd) of the 3D window with the pen and surface of their cut faces, and the custom cut pen and surface, in the form accepted by Set3DCutPlanes.

commands.name: Get3DStyleDetails
commands.description: Gets the settings of 3D styles by name (an empty name or no names means the current 3D style): rendering engine, model type, monochrome and background colors, contours, shadows and hatching.

commands.name: Create3DStyles
commands.description: Creates 3D styles.

commands.name: Change3DStyles
commands.description: Changes the given fields of existing 3D styles, identified by name.

commands.name: Get3DProjectionSettings
commands.description: Gets the 3D projection settings of the 3D window: whether it is perspective or axonometric, the camera and target position, view cone, roll angle, distance and azimuth of a perspective, or the projection type, azimuth and transformation matrix of an axonometry, and the sun position of either (date and time or azimuth and altitude).

commands.name: Set3DProjectionSettings
commands.description: Sets a perspective or an axonometric projection for the 3D window.

commands.name: GetCameras
commands.description: Gets the Camera Sets (camera paths) of the project with their name, whether the set is the active one, its current camera, and its cameras in path order.

commands.name: CreateCameraSets
commands.description: Creates empty Camera Sets (camera paths) with the given names, and makes one the active Camera Set when isActive is true.

commands.name: ModifyCameraSets
commands.description: Renames Camera Sets (camera paths) and makes one of them the active Camera Set (isActive true); the set active before is then no longer active.

commands.name: CreateCameras
commands.description: Creates perspective cameras, each added at the end of the path of the given Camera Set, from the camera and target positions (with their heights) and optionally the view cone, roll angle, two-point perspective, sun (by angles or by date and time) and pen; the rest comes from the Camera tool defaults.

commands.name: ModifyCameras
commands.description: Changes perspective cameras: the camera and target positions (with their heights), view cone, roll angle, two-point perspective, sun (by angles or by date and time) and pen.

commands.name: Get3DStyles
commands.description: Gets the names of the 3D styles of the project and the name of the current one, which the 3D window uses.

commands.name: SetCurrent3DStyle
commands.description: Meant to make the given 3D style, one of the names Get3DStyles returns, the current one.

commands.name: StoreViewSettings
commands.description: Stores the current view settings (action Store) and puts them back later (action Restore), for example before and after a script that changes the view.

commands.name: ShowElementsIn3D
commands.description: Opens the 3D window on the given elements, as Show Selection in 3D does: they become the selection and only they are shown.

commands.name: GetDocumentFrom3DDefaults
commands.description: Gets the defaults a newly created 3D Document starts with: name, reference ID, vectorial hatching and sun shadows, transparency, connection to the model, surfaces, boundary contours and the uniform cut, uncut, shadow and hidden edge attributes.

commands.name: SetDocumentFrom3DDefaults
commands.description: Sets the defaults a newly created 3D Document starts with.

commands.name: Get3DWindowSettings
commands.description: Gets the 3D window settings: the pixel size of the 3D window and the zoom (scale and displacement) of its projection.

commands.name: Set3DWindowSettings
commands.description: Changes the pixel size of the 3D window and/or the zoom (scale and displacement) of its projection; the values not given are kept.

commands.name: Get3DDocumentSettings
commands.description: Gets the settings of a 3D Document, given by its navigator item: the element and story filter, the 3D cut, the projection, the window and zoom, the uniform cut and uncut surface attributes, the source and the boundary contours, with the field names of API_DocumentFrom3DType.

commands.name: Set3DDocumentSettings
commands.description: Changes the given settings of a 3D Document, given by its navigator item, in the form Get3DDocumentSettings returns; the settings not given are kept.

commands.name: Get3DFilterAndCutSettings
commands.description: Gets the 'Filter and Cut Elements in 3D' settings of the 3D window: the stories shown, the filter mode and which element types are shown.

commands.name: Set3DFilterAndCutSettings
commands.description: Changes the 'Filter and Cut Elements in 3D' settings of the 3D window; only the given fields and the listed element types change.

commands.name: GetGridSettings
commands.description: Gets the grid and snap grid settings of the database of the current window, and which database that is.

commands.name: SetGridSettings
commands.description: Changes the grid and snap grid settings of the database of the current window; only the given fields change.

commands.name: FitInWindow
commands.description: Zooms to the given elements or fits everything in the window.

commands.name: ZoomToElements
commands.description: Zooms the current window, 2D or 3D, to the given elements: selects them, zooms to the selection and restores the previous selection unless keepSelection is false.

commands.name: SetZoom
commands.description: Zooms the current 2D window to the given box in model coordinates.

commands.name: ResetZoom
commands.description: Steps back in the zoom history of the current window, like Archicad's Zoom Back.

commands.name: CreateSections
commands.description: Creates Section elements on the floor plan.

commands.name: ModifySections
commands.description: Changes the name and the reference ID of Section and Elevation elements, which the Project Map and the markers show, and moves their section line (startCoordinate, endCoordinate) and depth line (depth, only with the horizontal range Limited, which SetSectionsAndElevationsDetails sets).

commands.name: CreateInteriorElevations
commands.description: Creates Interior Elevation elements on the floor plan.

commands.name: CreateElevations
commands.description: Creates Elevation elements on the floor plan.

commands.name: GetSectionsAndElevationsDetails
commands.description: Gets every configurable setting of the given Section and Elevation elements, with their name and reference ID.

commands.name: SetSectionsAndElevationsDetails
commands.description: Sets settings of the given Section and Elevation elements: pens, line types, horizontal and vertical range, model effects, story handles and markers.

commands.name: SetInteriorElevationsDetails
commands.description: Sets settings of the given Interior Elevation elements: the stories they are shown on, the common marker's visibility, pen, font and sizes, and for each segment, chosen by its index in GetDetailsOfElements' segments, its name, reference ID and the segment settings of SetSectionsAndElevationsDetails.

commands.name: MoveNavigatorItem
commands.description: Moves a navigator item to a new parent in the navigator tree, or to a new position within its current parent.

commands.name: RenameNavigatorItem
commands.description: Renames a navigator item or changes its ID.

commands.name: DeleteNavigatorItems
commands.description: Deletes navigator items from the navigator tree: views and folders of the View Map, layouts and master layouts of the Layout Book, and independent worksheets and details of the Project Map.

commands.name: GetNavigatorItemTree
commands.description: Returns the full navigator item tree for the specified map.

commands.name: GetSchedules
commands.description: Returns the Interactive Schedules of the Project Map: navigator item id, name, ID and the folders they are in.

commands.name: GetNavigatorParentItems
commands.description: Returns the parent of each given navigator item: the folder, subset or layout book item it is in.

commands.name: SetMasterLayoutContext
commands.description: Sets which layout's context the master layout of the current window is drawn in: its autotexts then show the values of the given layout.

commands.name: GetAddOnViewpointRoots
commands.description: Returns the roots of the add-on viewpoints: the Project Map items created through the Archicad API by an add-on, as Archicad lists them to Tapir.

commands.name: GetAddOnViewpointChildren
commands.description: Returns the direct children of an add-on viewpoint root or group.

commands.name: GetAddOnViewpoints
commands.description: Returns the details of the given add-on viewpoint items: their parent, type (Root, Group or Leaf), ID, name, view settings flags and attached data (base64 encoded).

commands.name: CreateAddOnViewpoints
commands.description: Creates add-on viewpoint roots, groups and leaf nodes in the Project Map, with their ID, name, view settings flags (leaf nodes only) and attached data (base64 encoded).

commands.name: ChangeAddOnViewpoints
commands.description: Changes the ID, name, view settings flags or attached data (base64 encoded) of the given add-on viewpoint items; only the given fields are changed.

commands.name: ReorderNavigatorItems
commands.description: Reorders the children of a navigator item to match the given order.

commands.name: CreateGraphicalOverrideRule
commands.description: Creates or overwrites a graphic override rule in a rule group: name, criterion XML, surface color and line pen.

commands.name: GetGraphicalOverrideRules
commands.description: Returns every graphic override rule with its criterion XML.

commands.name: CreateGraphicalOverrideCombination
commands.description: Creates a graphic override combination from rule names, or replaces the rules of an existing one.

commands.name: GetGraphicalOverrideStyleOfElements
commands.description: Returns the graphic override style each element is drawn with in the current window: for every overridable member (line type, pens, fill types, surfaces, ...) whether the active graphic override combination replaces it, and with what.

commands.name: CreateIssue
commands.description: Creates a new issue.

commands.name: DeleteIssue
commands.description: Deletes the specified issue.

commands.name: GetIssues
commands.description: Retrieves information about existing issues.

commands.name: AddCommentToIssue
commands.description: Adds a new comment to the specified issue.

commands.name: GetCommentsFromIssue
commands.description: Retrieves comments information from the specified issue.

commands.name: AttachElementsToIssue
commands.description: Attaches elements to the specified issue.

commands.name: DetachElementsFromIssue
commands.description: Detaches elements from the specified issue.

commands.name: GetElementsAttachedToIssue
commands.description: Retrieves attached elements of the specified issue, filtered by attachment type.

commands.name: ExportIssuesToBCF
commands.description: Exports specified issues to a BCF file.

commands.name: ImportIssuesFromBCF
commands.description: Imports issues from the specified BCF file.

commands.name: ImportMarkupsFromPDF
commands.description: Imports the markups of the specified PDF file as issues, like Issue Manager > Import PDF markups, without any dialog and without opening the Issue Manager palette, and reports the issues it created.

commands.name: GetRevisionIssues
commands.description: Retrieves all issues.

commands.name: ModifyRevisionIssues
commands.description: Modifies the ID, the short description and the custom scheme data of the given revision issues.

commands.name: GetRevisionChanges
commands.description: Retrieves all changes.

commands.name: GetRevisionChangeCustomScheme
commands.description: Retrieves the custom fields of changes (the change custom scheme): the key and the name of each field.

commands.name: GetDocumentRevisions
commands.description: Retrieves all document revisions.

commands.name: GetCurrentRevisionChangesOfLayouts
commands.description: Retrieves all changes belong to the last revision of the given layouts.

commands.name: GetRevisionChangesOfElements
commands.description: Retrieves the changes belong to the given elements.

commands.name: CreateChangeMarkers
commands.description: Creates Change Markers (revision clouds) in the database of the active window, each with a cloud polygon, its marker components, the position it points to and the position of its marker head.

commands.name: ModifyChangeMarkers
commands.description: Changes existing Change Markers (revision clouds) with the keys CreateChangeMarkers takes and GetDetailsOfElements returns: the Change the marker is linked to (an existing Change by its ID, a new Change made with createChange, or no Change with linkType Unlinked), the marker components, the angle and always-horizontal setting of the marker head, the position of the marker head (markerPosition), and the point a marker without a cloud polygon points to (position).

commands.name: GetDesignOptions
commands.description: Retrieves information about existing design options.

commands.name: GetDesignOptionSets
commands.description: Retrieves information about existing design option sets, and in Teamwork projects the Teamwork identifier of the design options.

commands.name: GetDesignOptionCombinations
commands.description: Retrieves information about existing design option combinations.

commands.name: GetElementsOfDesignOptions
commands.description: Retrieves the elements associated with the given design options.

commands.name: GetDesignOptionForElements
commands.description: Retrieves the design option association for the specified elements.

commands.name: CreateDesignOptionSets
commands.description: Creates new design option sets with the given names.

commands.name: CreateDesignOptions
commands.description: Creates new design options with the given parameters.

commands.name: CreateDesignOptionCombinations
commands.description: Creates new design option combinations with the given parameters.

commands.name: SetActiveDesignOptionsInCombinations
commands.description: Sets active design options in the given combinations.

commands.name: ActivateDesignOptionsInCombinations
commands.description: Activates one design option in each of the given combinations, without listing all active design options of the combination.

commands.name: DeactivateDesignOptionsInCombinations
commands.description: Turns off the given design options in the given combinations, leaving their other options as they are.

commands.name: MoveElementsToDesignOptions
commands.description: Moves the given elements into the given design options.

commands.name: MoveDesignOptionsToAnotherSet
commands.description: Moves the given design options to another sets.

commands.name: RenameDesignOptions
commands.description: Changes the name and/or the string id of the given design options.

commands.name: RenameDesignOptionSets
commands.description: Changes the name of the given design option sets.

commands.name: RenameDesignOptionCombinations
commands.description: Changes the name of the given design option combinations.

commands.name: DeleteDesignOptions
commands.description: Deletes the given design options.

commands.name: DeleteDesignOptionSets
commands.description: Deletes the given design option sets.

commands.name: DeleteDesignOptionCombinations
commands.description: Deletes the given design option combinations.

commands.name: GetHotlinkDesignOptionTables
commands.description: Retrieves the design option table of the given hotlink nodes and placed hotlink instances: the filter mode (main model only, by options or by combination), the design option sets, options and combinations of the hotlinked module and which of them are active.

commands.name: SetHotlinkDesignOptionTables
commands.description: Sets the filter mode, the active combination and the active option of sets in the design option table of the given placed hotlink instances.

commands.name: SetDefaultDesignOption
commands.description: Sets the given design option as the default, or the Main Model when no design option is given.

commands.name: GetDefaultDesignOption
commands.description: Retrieves which design option, or the Main Model, is the default that new elements go to.

commands.name: ReorderDesignOptionSets
commands.description: Moves the given design option sets before another set or to the end of the list.

commands.name: ReorderDesignOptionsInSet
commands.description: Moves the given design options before another design option of the same set or to the end of their set.

commands.name: CanMoveElementsToDesignOptions
commands.description: Checks whether the given elements can be moved to another design option or to the main model, with the reason when they cannot.

commands.name: DuplicateDesignOptionCombinations
commands.description: Duplicates the given design option combinations and returns the identifiers of the new combinations.

commands.name: GetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews
commands.description: Retrieves which design option combination the given views show: only the main model, a combination, a custom set of design options or a deleted combination.

commands.name: SetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews
commands.description: Sets the design option combination the given views show, or makes them show only the main model.

commands.name: GetHotlinkDesignOptionTableDetails
commands.description: Reads the design option table of hotlink nodes: the design option sets, options and combinations of the hotlinked source file, and which of them the node shows.

commands.name: GetKeynoteTree
commands.description: Retrieves the whole keynote folder and item hierarchy.

commands.name: GetKeynoteAutoTexts
commands.description: Retrieves the autotext tokens of the given keynote items.

commands.name: CreateKeynoteFolders
commands.description: Creates keynote folders under the given parent folders (or under the root folder).

commands.name: CreateKeynoteItems
commands.description: Creates keynote items in the given parent folders (or in the root folder).

commands.name: ModifyKeynoteFolders
commands.description: Modifies the key, title or reference of the given keynote folders.

commands.name: ModifyKeynoteItems
commands.description: Modifies the key, title, description or reference of the given keynote items.

commands.name: DeleteKeynoteFolders
commands.description: Deletes the given keynote folders including their content.

commands.name: DeleteKeynoteItems
commands.description: Deletes the given keynote items.

commands.name: CreateKeynoteLabels
commands.description: Creates Label elements that reference the given keynote items via autotext.

commands.name: GetProjectDataKeys
commands.description: Lists the project data stored by Tapir in the project: the names, the identifiers of the add-on objects that store them, whether they are kept on this client only and the Teamwork user who has reserved them.

commands.name: GetProjectData
commands.description: Gets the content of the project data with the given names.

commands.name: SetProjectData
commands.description: Creates or overwrites project data: text (for example JSON) saved in the project under a name.

commands.name: DeleteProjectData
commands.description: Deletes the project data with the given names.

commands.name: ReserveProjectData
commands.description: Reserves the project data with the given names in Teamwork, so that other users cannot change it.

commands.name: ReleaseProjectData
commands.description: Releases the project data with the given names in Teamwork.

commands.name: RequestProjectData
commands.description: Requests the project data with the given names in Teamwork from the users who have reserved it, with an optional message.

commands.name: GrantProjectData
commands.description: Grants the project data with the given names, reserved by the current user, to another Teamwork user.

commands.name: GetModulData
commands.description: Gets the module data Tapir stored in the project with StoreModulData: the given names, or all of them, with their data version and, unless includeContent is false, their content.

commands.name: StoreModulData
commands.description: Creates or overwrites module data: text (for example JSON) saved in the project under a name, with an optional data version.

commands.name: DeleteModulData
commands.description: Deletes the module data with the given names.

commands.name: GetMEPElements
commands.description: Retrieves the MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) elements of the project (every element the MEP API lists, and from Archicad 30 the electrical panels and devices), optionally filtered by type and domain.

commands.name: GetMEPRoutingElements
commands.description: Retrieves the details of the given MEP routing elements: domain, MEP system, offset from the home story, branch preference table, the ports logically connected at the route's beginning and end, the floor plan display settings (cut plane position, floor plan display option, show projection and on-story visibility, from Archicad 29), route polyline, segments with cross section data (shape, size, preference table and reference id), begin and end nodes, anchor, reference line offsets, wall thickness, flange size, connection style, insulation thickness and rigid segments, and nodes with their incoming and outgoing segments, preferred transition placement, elbows and transitions, and the node positions with the key ModifyMEPRoutingElements writes them with.

commands.name: GetMEPPorts
commands.description: Retrieves the ports of the given MEP elements including position, shape, size, connection status (Archicad 27: whether the port is connected, from Archicad 28: whether it is physically connected) and connection style (from Archicad 30), the flow direction of piping and ventilation ports (from Archicad 28), the nominal size of piping ports (from Archicad 30), and the outer diameter, wall thickness and flange size (Archicad 30) of piping and ventilation ports.

commands.name: GetMEPDistributionSystems
commands.description: Retrieves the MEP distribution systems of the project with their domain, MEP system attribute, member elements, physical systems (from Archicad 29) and optionally their tree: the elements from the root element on, each with its previous and next elements and the connecting ports.

commands.name: CreateMEPRoutingElements
commands.description: Creates MEP routing elements (duct, pipe or cable carrier routes) along the given polylines with optional cross section data (shape, size, preference table and reference id), MEP system and layer (also set on the segments, elbows and transitions), and optional elbow and transition defaults (preference tables and elbow radius factor, from Archicad 29) that apply only to what is placed.

commands.name: CreateMEPElements
commands.description: Creates MEP elements (Terminal, Accessory, Equipment or Fitting) at the given positions, optionally with another library part, size (from Archicad 30), MEP system, port sizes and shapes and a changed insulation, which apply only to what is placed.

commands.name: ModifyMEPRoutingElements
commands.description: Modifies the given MEP routing elements: MEP system, branch preference table, floor plan display settings (cut plane position, floor plan display option, show projection and on-story visibility, from Archicad 29), cross section data (shape, size, preference table and reference id), anchor, reference line offsets, wall thickness, flange size and connection style of all segments, preferred transition placement of all nodes, insulation thickness of the whole route (segments, elbows and transitions), and node positions.

commands.name: RebuildMEPRoutingElements
commands.description: Rebuilds the given MEP routing elements along new node coordinates or along their current polyline: this adds or removes nodes (bend points), leaves out with removeCollinearNodes the nodes where the route goes straight on (as Purge Unused MEP Nodes does), and with resetCustomSegments resets customized segments and nodes (as Reset Custom Segments does).

commands.name: ModifyMEPPorts
commands.description: Modifies the given MEP ports (as returned by GetMEPPorts): shape, width, height (not of piping ports), connection style (from Archicad 30), the flow direction of piping and ventilation ports, and the outer diameter and nominal size (from Archicad 30) of piping ports.

commands.name: ConnectMEPElements
commands.description: Connects MEP routing elements to other MEP elements or routes.

commands.name: CheckMEPPortConnectability
commands.description: Checks whether MEP ports can be connected to other ports, for the given pairs of ports.

commands.name: GetMEPPreferenceTables
commands.description: Gets the circular cross section preference tables (referenceId, diameter, wall thickness, description) and the reference set of the Piping or Ventilation domain, optionally with the elbow, branch and transition preference tables, plus the rectangular duct tables of the Ventilation domain or the segment tables of the CableCarrier domain.

commands.name: ModifyMEPPreferenceTables
commands.description: Modifies the MEP preference tables of a domain, in the shape GetMEPPreferenceTables returns them: adds tables, changes their names, segmentation lengths (from Archicad 29) and row values and descriptions, deletes or empties rows, adds rows to the rectangular duct and cable carrier tables, deletes tables, deletes reference ids from the reference set, and adds and deletes angles of the angle set (from Archicad 29).

commands.name: GetMEPSystemGroups
commands.description: Gets the MEP system groups of the project with their physical systems: name, editable flag, root element and MEP system.

commands.name: CreateMEPSystemGroups
commands.description: Creates MEP system groups.

commands.name: CreateMEPPhysicalSystems
commands.description: Creates physical systems in MEP system groups, optionally with a root element and an MEP system as their category.

commands.name: ModifyMEPSystemGroups
commands.description: Renames MEP system groups.

commands.name: ModifyMEPPhysicalSystems
commands.description: Modifies MEP physical systems: name, root element and the MEP system used as their category.

commands.name: DeleteMEPPhysicalSystems
commands.description: Removes MEP physical systems from their system groups.

commands.name: GetMEPToolDefaults
commands.description: Retrieves the current settings of the MEP tools per domain, without changing them: the routing tool (MEP system, branch preference table, floor plan display settings from Archicad 29, and its segment, node, elbow (Archicad 27 and from Archicad 29) and transition defaults), its rigid segment and branch defaults, the flexible segment tool, the library part, insulation and port settings of the terminal, accessory, fitting and equipment tools, and from Archicad 30 the electrical panel tool with its number of circuit defaults.

commands.name: TransferMEPSettings
commands.description: Picks up the settings of an MEP element and injects them into other MEP elements of the same type and domain, like Archicad's pick up and inject parameters.

commands.name: GetMEPPhysicalSystemsOfElements
commands.description: Returns the physical systems each of the given MEP elements is part of.

commands.name: CreateMEPFlexibleSegments
commands.description: Creates MEP flexible segments through the given control points, or along a polyline of alternating line and spline parts (Piping), with the current settings of the Flexible Segment tool of their domain, optionally with the orientation (control points) or direction (polyline) at both ends.

commands.name: CreateMEPTakeOffs
commands.description: Creates MEP take-offs on the given routing segments, at a distance from the beginning of the segment (not more than its length) and optionally rotated around its axis by a multiple of 90 degrees, with the current settings of the Take-Off tool of their domain (by default the domain of the segment's routing element), optionally with their length and without insulation, which apply only to what is created.

commands.name: ModifyMEPElements
commands.description: Modifies placed MEP elements: the anchor point, orientation and library part of terminals, accessories, equipment, fittings and flexible segments, their size along the local x and y axes (from Archicad 30), the control points, polyline (Piping, from Archicad 28), and width and height of flexible segments.

commands.name: GetMEPRoutingParameters
commands.description: Gets the routing parameters of placed MEP elements: of a routing element its routing node parameters (preferred transition placement, elbow from Archicad 29, transition) and routing segment parameters (cross section, preference table, anchor, reference line offsets, wall thickness, flange size, connection style); of a routing node its elbow (from Archicad 29) and transition parameters; of a routing segment its rigid segment parameters (Archicad 28 only).

commands.name: SetMEPRoutingParameters
commands.description: Sets the routing parameters of placed MEP elements: the routing segment parameters (cross section and preference table) and, from Archicad 29, the routing node parameters (elbow radius factor and preference table, transition preference table) of routing elements, and the elbow and transition parameters of routing nodes (from Archicad 29).

commands.name: GetElectricalPanels
commands.description: Gets the electrical panels (distribution boards) of the project or the given ones: name, circuit naming, circuits, parent circuit, placement and the connected and demand loads in total and per phase.

commands.name: GetElectricalCircuits
commands.description: Gets the given electrical circuits, the circuits of the given panels, or every circuit of the project: name, description, owner panel, connected devices and panels, voltage, phases, wiring type, loads, voltage drop and estimated cable length.

commands.name: GetElectricalDevices
commands.description: Gets the electrical devices (lights, sockets and other consumers) of the project or the given ones: parent circuit, placement, apparent power, load classification, demand load and directly connected MEP elements.

commands.name: GetElectricalProjectSettings
commands.description: Gets the electrical project settings: the default voltage, the wiring types with their cross-sectional area and the load classifications with their demand factor.

commands.name: CreateElectricalPanels
commands.description: Places electrical panels with the default settings of the Electrical Panel tool, optionally with the given library part, size, rotation, mirroring, panel name and circuit naming.

commands.name: CreateElectricalDevices
commands.description: Places electrical devices with the default settings of the Electrical Device tool, optionally with the given library part, size, rotation, mirroring, apparent power and load classification, and connects them to a circuit.

commands.name: ModifyElectricalPanels
commands.description: Modifies the name, circuit naming and placement (anchor point, orientation, rotation, mirroring, library part, size) of electrical panels.

commands.name: CreateElectricalCircuits
commands.description: Adds new circuits to electrical panels, optionally with the given description, voltage, wiring type and used phases.

commands.name: DeleteElectricalCircuits
commands.description: Removes electrical circuits from their panels.

commands.name: ModifyElectricalCircuits
commands.description: Modifies the description, voltage, wiring type and used phases of electrical circuits.

commands.name: ModifyElectricalDevices
commands.description: Modifies the apparent power, load classification and placement (anchor point, orientation, rotation, mirroring, library part, size) of electrical devices.

commands.name: ConnectToElectricalCircuits
commands.description: Connects electrical devices, or panels as sub-panels, to electrical circuits.

commands.name: ModifyElectricalProjectSettings
commands.description: Modifies the electrical project settings: sets the default voltage and clears, adds or removes wiring types and load classifications.

commands.name: GetMEPElementDetails
commands.description: Retrieves the type-specific details of the given MEP elements: insulation thickness and routing segment of rigid segments, control points and polyline of flexible segments, radius factor, insulation thickness, preference table and routing node of elbows (from Archicad 29), angle, length and insulation thickness of branches, and offsets, wider and narrower ports, insulation thickness, routing node and (from Archicad 29) preference table of transitions; the width and height of flexible segments, and the anchor point, orientation, library part and (from Archicad 30) size of the elements ModifyMEPElements places, with the keys it writes them with.

commands.name: GetMEPPreferenceTableRows
commands.description: Gets rows of a segment, branch, elbow or (from Archicad 29) transition preference table by their key (the reference ids and, for branch and elbow rows from Archicad 29, the angle): whether the row is valid and its values (diameters, wall thickness, radius, length, angle, branch offset, connection length, description), and whether the table exists.

commands.name: SetMEPPreferenceTableRows
commands.description: Sets the given values of rows of a segment, branch, elbow or (from Archicad 29) transition preference table, found by their key (the reference ids and, for branch and elbow rows from Archicad 29, the angle).

commands.name: AddMEPPreferenceTableRows
commands.description: Adds rows with the given keys and optionally values to a branch, elbow or transition preference table and returns their index, in one undo step.

commands.name: DeleteMEPPreferenceTableRows
commands.description: Deletes rows of a segment, branch, elbow or (from Archicad 29) transition preference table by their key (the reference ids and, for branch and elbow rows from Archicad 29, the angle), in one undo step.

commands.name: GetMEPPreferenceTableContainers
commands.description: Lists the preference tables of the Piping, Ventilation and Cable Carrier preference table containers of Archicad 27: their id, name, whether they exist and their number of rows per shape, and whether the container exists.

commands.name: CreateMEPPreferenceTables
commands.description: Adds empty preference tables with the given names to the preference table container of a domain of Archicad 27 and returns their id, in one undo step.

commands.name: GetCurrentAnalyticalModel
commands.description: Retrieves the Structural Analytical Model created for the current view.

commands.name: UpdateAnalyticalModel
commands.description: Triggers an update of the given Structural Analytical Model, or of the model of the current view when no model is given.

commands.name: SetAnalyticalGenerationSettingsToNoRule
commands.description: Sets the generation settings of the current Structural Analytical Model to no rules.

commands.name: GetAnalyticalModelCheckTypeId
commands.description: Retrieves the type identifier of the Structural Analytical Model check.

commands.name: GetAnalyticalModelVariation
commands.description: Retrieves the variation of the given Structural Analytical Model, or of the model of the current view when no model is given (the model is required before Archicad 27).

commands.name: GetAnalyticalModel
commands.description: Retrieves the Structural Analytical Model of the given variation, as returned by GetAnalyticalModelVariation.

commands.name: GetAnalyticalVisibilitySettings
commands.description: Retrieves the visibility settings of the Structural Analytical Model.

commands.name: SetAnalyticalVisibilitySettings
commands.description: Changes the given fields of the Structural Analytical Model visibility settings; the others keep their value.

commands.name: GetAnalyticalMemberTypesOfElements
commands.description: Retrieves the analytical member type (Beam, Column, Roof, Slab, Wall or Unknown) of the given elements from the Complementary Project, the structural analysis project exchanged with Archicad.

commands.name: GetAnalyticalLoadGroups
commands.description: Retrieves the structural analysis load groups of the project, or the ones given by their ids, with all their fields.

commands.name: GetAnalyticalLoadCases
commands.description: Retrieves the structural analysis load cases of the given load group, or of the project when no load group is given, with all their fields.

commands.name: GetAnalyticalLoadCombinations
commands.description: Retrieves the structural analysis load combinations of the project, or the ones given by their ids, with all their fields and load factors.

commands.name: CreateAnalyticalLoadGroups
commands.description: Creates structural analysis load groups in one undo step and returns their identifiers.

commands.name: CreateAnalyticalLoadCases
commands.description: Creates structural analysis load cases in the given load groups in one undo step and returns their identifiers.

commands.name: CreateAnalyticalLoadCombinations
commands.description: Creates structural analysis load combinations, optionally with their load factors, in one undo step and returns their identifiers.

commands.name: DeleteAnalyticalLoadGroups
commands.description: Deletes the given structural analysis load groups in one undo step.

commands.name: DeleteAnalyticalLoadCases
commands.description: Deletes the given structural analysis load cases in one undo step.

commands.name: DeleteAnalyticalLoadCombinations
commands.description: Deletes the given structural analysis load combinations in one undo step.

commands.name: AddLoadCasesToLoadCombination
commands.description: Adds load cases with their factors to the given structural analysis load combination in one undo step.

commands.name: GetAnalyticalMembers
commands.description: Lists the elements of the curve and surface members of the given Structural Analytical Model, or of the model of the current view when no model is given (the model is required before Archicad 27).

commands.name: GetAnalyticalMemberDetails
commands.description: Retrieves the curve, surface or segmented surface member of the given elements in a Structural Analytical Model, with their connections.

commands.name: GetAnalyticalReleases
commands.description: Retrieves the releases of the given analytical members.

commands.name: SetAnalyticalReleases
commands.description: Replaces the releases of the given analytical members, in one undo step.

commands.name: GetCustomCurveMemberStretch
commands.description: Retrieves the lengths added to the start and end of the given curve members.

commands.name: SetCustomCurveMemberStretch
commands.description: Sets the lengths added to the start and end of the given curve members, in one undo step.

commands.name: GetLCSOfAnalyticalMembers
commands.description: Retrieves the local coordinate system of the given analytical member parts, optionally in their intersection with another member part.

commands.name: GetAnalyticalMemberPartGeometries
commands.description: Retrieves the node of the given analytical member vertices and the curve of the given member edges.

commands.name: GetAnalyticalSupports
commands.description: Retrieves the settings, the supported member part and the geometry of the given analytical supports.

commands.name: GetAnalyticalLinks
commands.description: Retrieves the settings, the connected member parts and the geometry of the given analytical links.

commands.name: CreateAnalyticalSupports
commands.description: Creates analytical supports from their settings and supported member part, as GetAnalyticalSupports returns them, in one undo step.

commands.name: CreateAnalyticalLinks
commands.description: Creates analytical links from their settings and connected member parts, as GetAnalyticalLinks returns them, in one undo step.

commands.name: ConvertAnalyticalLinksToNonShortest
commands.description: Converts the given shortest analytical links (associative to a curve member or a surface member edge) to links connected to a fixed coordinate, in one undo step, and returns the converted links.

commands.name: GetAnalyticalLoads
commands.description: Retrieves the settings, the loaded member part, the custom data (the curve of an edge load, the contour of a surface load) and the geometry of the given analytical point, edge and surface loads.

commands.name: CreateAnalyticalLoads
