commands.description: Creates analytical point, edge and surface loads from their settings, loaded member part and custom data, as GetAnalyticalLoads returns them, in one undo step.

commands.name: CreateElementsFromAnalyticalMembers
commands.description: Creates elements (beams, columns, walls, slabs, roofs) from the given curve, surface or segmented surface members, in the form GetAnalyticalMemberDetails returns them, optionally with the settings of a favorite, in one undo step.

commands.name: CreateSolidElementLinks
commands.description: Creates solid element operation links between target and operator elements.

commands.name: RemoveSolidElementLinks
commands.description: Removes solid element operation links between target and operator elements.

commands.name: GetSolidElementLinks
commands.description: Returns solid element operation links for each queried element, grouped by role (target or operator).

commands.name: CreateSolidOperations
commands.description: Runs a solid operation (subtraction, intersection, addition) on two morphs and returns the resulting morphs, one item per operation.

commands.name: TrimElements
commands.description: Trims construction elements with a roof or shell: the roofs and shells in the list, or one given trimming element with a trim type.

commands.name: RemoveElementTrims
commands.description: Removes the trim between an element and the roof or shell trimming it.

commands.name: RemoveElementTrimDirection
commands.description: Removes one direction of a trim: the trim of an element by a roof or shell, keeping the other direction when the two trim each other (two roofs or shells).

commands.name: GetElementTrims
commands.description: Which roofs and shells trim each queried element, with the trim type, and which elements it trims.

commands.name: MergeElements
commands.description: Merges the given construction elements (the Merge command of Archicad, which cleans up the junctions of slabs, beams, walls and similar elements).

commands.name: UnmergeElements
commands.description: Removes the merge between the two elements of each given pair.

commands.name: GetMergedElements
commands.description: Gets the elements each queried element is merged with, one item per queried element; an unknown element is an error item.

commands.name: ShowScriptUI
commands.description: Shows the given HTML content in a native Archicad palette (a tkinter alternative for Python scripts) and returns the uiId of its window.

commands.name: GetScriptUIResult
commands.description: Retrieves and clears the result last submitted from a Script UI window's page (via window.ACAPI.SubmitResult), if any, and reports whether the window is still open, so a waiting script can stop when the user closes it.

commands.name: OpenSettingsDialog
commands.description: Opens Archicad's settings dialog of the selected elements or the current tool (Archicad 28 and later), or the default settings dialog of the given element type, waits for the user and reports whether the dialog was closed with OK or Cancel.

commands.name: PickLibraryPart
commands.description: Opens Archicad's Object, Lamp, Window or Door Settings dialog, optionally limited to a library part subtype, lets the user pick a library part and set its parameters, and returns the chosen library part with its GDL parameters, or that the user cancelled.

commands.name: PickLibraryPartFile
commands.description: Opens Archicad's Open Library Part dialog, waits for the user and returns the location of the chosen library part, or reports that the user cancelled.

commands.name: PickPictureFile
commands.description: Opens Archicad's Open Picture dialog (the one of the texture settings), waits for the user and returns the location of the chosen picture, or reports that the user cancelled.

commands.name: PickZoneStampOrLabelFile
commands.description: Opens Archicad's dialog for opening a zone stamp or label library part, waits for the user and returns the location of the chosen file, or reports that the user cancelled.

commands.name: PickLibraryPartSaveLocation
commands.description: Opens Archicad's Save Library Part dialog (object, door or window), waits for the user and returns the location chosen to save the library part to, or reports that the user cancelled.

commands.name: PickLibraryFolder
commands.description: Opens Archicad's dialog for choosing or creating a library folder, waits for the user and returns the location of the folder, or reports that the user cancelled.

commands.name: ShowIFCExportSettings
commands.description: Opens Archicad's IFC export settings dialog, where the user picks a view and an IFC export translator, waits for the user and returns the chosen view and translator, or cancelled.

commands.name: PickAttribute
commands.description: Opens a small dialog with Archicad's attribute picker for the given attribute type (layer, building material, composite, profile or surface; fill and line from Archicad 27), waits for the user and returns the chosen attribute, or cancelled.

commands.name: PickAttributeFolder
commands.description: Opens a small dialog with Archicad's attribute folder picker for the given attribute type, waits for the user and returns the chosen folder as its path from the root folder, or cancelled.

commands.name: GenerateDocumentation
commands.description: Generates files for the documentation.
